jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**

As a Project Coordinator, you will provide essential administrative and organizational support to project managers, ensuring smooth execution and tracking. Your role is vital for maintaining timelines, managing resources, and facilitating effective project communication.  
  
Every day you will assist with scheduling, prepare documentation, track deliverables, and monitor progress. You'll also coordinate resources, manage team communications, and help resolve minor issues to keep projects on track.  
  
To be successful, you need strong organizational/administrative skills, meticulous attention to detail, and excellent communication.

* Develops and implements the work plan and workflow of the department’s grants and major projects.
* Oversees the operation of the mobile unit. Which includes but not limited to: scheduling site visits, maintaining monthly calendar, CBISA reporting, and ordering supplies.
* Collects and utilizes data to ensure the completion of all grants and projects.
* Manages the timeline and budgets for each stage of the department grants and projects.

**Job Requirements**

Required

* Experience in working with grants and/or project management.
* BA/BS degree or a minimum of five years’ experience managing grants and/or projects.
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Google Workspace.

Preferred

* Bilingual (English/Spanish)

  
Where You'll Work

Founded in 1923, Dignity Health - St. Mary Medical Center is a 389-bed, acute care, nonprofit hospital located in Long Beach, California. Serving over 80,000 patients annually, the hospital offers a full complement of services including a Level II Trauma Center, Level III NICU, heart care, and orthopedics. Additionally, St. Mary Medical Center has been recognized as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality High Performer by the Human Rights Campaign Foundation. It is a Joint Commission-certified Thrombectomy-Capable Stroke Center and received a Healthgrades 5-Star Award for Heart Failure in 2026. One Community. One Mission. One California

$27.98 - $41.62 /hour

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Hope Mission Statement**

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Interim housing programs run on direct service and leadership. What keeps them running — accurately, compliantly, and without things falling through the cracks — is coordination. The Program Coordinator is responsible for that infrastructure.

Reporting to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager, the Program Coordinator provides the administrative, operational, and data coordination support that enables assigned HTM interim housing sites to function in alignment with agency policies, funder requirements, and contract standards. This role tracks documentation, monitors compliance tasks, maintains participant records in HMIS, reviews shift reports, follows up on incidents, and ensures that the operational details of daily program life are organized, accounted for, and ready for scrutiny. When audits happen, when monitoring visits arrive, when leadership needs to know whether documentation is current — the Program Coordinator is the reason the answer is yes.

This is not a supervisory role, and the distinction is deliberate. The Program Coordinator's value is in coordination, quality control, and follow-through — not authority. It requires someone who can hold a high volume of moving parts with precision and calm, who understands that a missing daily activity report or an untracked incident is not a paperwork problem but a compliance risk, and who takes both the operational and the relational dimensions of the work seriously. Programs do not run on good intentions. They run on systems, and this role is responsible for keeping those systems intact.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

*Data, Documentation & Compliance*

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date participant records in HMIS and other agency-approved data systems
* Track completion of required program documents including Daily Activity Reports (DARs), wellness check logs, incident report submissions, and case management documentation
* Conduct first-level review of documentation for completeness and accuracy; flag missing or late items for follow-up
* Submit and follow up on all incident reports in accordance with agency protocols
* Review shift reports regularly to monitor staff performance and documentation compliance
* Maintain organized participant files, rosters, logs, and trackers in accordance with program and funder requirements
* Assist with preparation for audits, monitoring visits, and internal reviews by gathering and organizing requested documentation
* Support program and contract compliance by regularly reviewing logs, records, and data against funder requirements

*Operations & Site Management*

* Monitor the medication cabinet and review all medication records
* Track supply inventory and submit facility maintenance, IT, and supply order requests with Program Manager approval
* Regularly inspect bathroom facilities, shelter rooms, and site surroundings to ensure clean, sanitary, and safe conditions
* Report maintenance issues and repair needs to the supervisor promptly
* Help train janitorial and hygiene staff on proper site and bathroom maintenance protocols
* Coordinate communication between shifts, departments, and program leadership regarding operational needs and follow-up items
* Provide on-site support during high-volume or high-need operational periods
* Work collaboratively with outsourced security staff to maintain safety for participants, staff, volunteers, and visitors
* Train staff on the use of security and surveillance systems

*Staff Support & Coordination*

* Provide direction and training to shelter support staff including Client Service Monitors and Case Managers in collaboration with the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager
* Maintain staff timesheets and daily activity reports as directed
* Support onboarding processes by coordinating training schedules, tracking credentials, and organizing required documentation
* Schedule meetings, case conferences, and staff training sessions as directed
* Provide staff coverage as needed, including substituting as a Client Service Monitor during absences
* Provide feedback to leadership on service delivery, program enhancements, and operational modifications as needed

*Participant & Community Engagement*

* Assist with participant issues including conflict resolution and complaint resolution using de-escalation and mediation techniques
* Provide emergency service referrals and warm handoffs for domestic violence, human trafficking, sexual assault, and other crisis needs as appropriate
* Ensure implementation of Housing First, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care principles across all participant interactions
* Support participant engagement activities, orientations, and program communications as assigned
* Support case management services to participants as needed
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with community partners including mental health programs, law enforcement, neighborhood councils, and service providers

*General*

* Assist leadership with special projects, reports, and data pulls as needed
* Attend staff meetings, case conferences, training workshops, and community meetings as required
* Coordinate external partners, service providers, and volunteers as directed
* Adhere to all organizational policies related to attendance, dress code, professionalism, and conduct
* Identify and report unsafe situations, systems, or processes to supervisors promptly
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Requirements**

* Must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings
* Must pass background check as required per worksite
* Must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the United States
* Must comply with all HTM policies including safety, confidentiality, conduct, and HIPAA sta

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Part-Time) - Housing
jobs.description:
**DEFINITION**
--------------

***Come work for the beautiful City of Redondo Beach located in Los Angeles County in the South Bay region known for its scenic beaches, relaxed seaside atmosphere, and vibrant waterfront as part of our Housing Authority Division of the Community Services Department.***

  

The Redondo Beach Housing Authority administers the Housing Choice Voucher rental assistance program. It also manages specialized programs such as Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing (VASH), Emergency Housing Vouchers (EHV), Project-Based Vouchers, and Foster Youth for Independence (FYI) programs that are funded by the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), which is a branch of the federal government.

  
Under direction of a supervisor, this position is responsible for performing paraprofessional duties and supporting the Housing Division staff with general clerical tasks. The position serves as the first contact for the Housing Division providing outstanding customer service to program participants and the public. Responsibilities also include addressing general inquiries regarding the Housing programs administered by the Housing Division.
  
  
This is a part-time, at-will position that is not eligible for City benefits. Only those applicants in which the hiring department is interested will receive further contact after application submission. Prompt application is encouraged.

**EXAMPLES OF DUTIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS**
---------------------------------------------------------

**Duties include, but are not limited to:**

* Reviews client applications for eligibility of rental assistance
* Monitors and supervises program participants
* Resolves concerns between tenant, landlord, and the Housing Authority
* Confers and collaborates with other social services providers as appropriate
* Collects and reports participant data to HUD
* Operates a motor vehicle in the performance of home inspections
* Conduct HUD NSPIRE inspections
* Performs other related duties as assigned

  
Perform various routine administrative duties, including data entry and operating standard office equipment such as a personal computer. Effective use of software such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Work in a professional office environment greeting patrons, answering telephones, filing, copying, scanning, proofreading documents, and other duties as assigned.  
  
  

Sample duties include, but are not limited to:

Perform daily administrative and clerical duties, including scheduling, data entry, record-keeping, correspondence, and conducts on-site HUD NSPIRE inspections of residential units for the Housing Division.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

Knowledge of: Materials, equipment, regulations, principles, procedures and practices related to youth and senior activities, recreational programs, group activities, games and sports; applicable health and safety regulations; first aid; record keeping practices and procedures; modern office practices, procedures and equipment; report writing; basic mathematical computations; applicable sections of the California Vehicle Code.
  
  
Ability to: Meet medical and physical employment standards for the classification; read, write, speak and understand English; understand and follow oral and written directions; compose correspondence, brochures, flyers and other informational documents; provide information to the public in person, by telephone, or through written correspondence where judgment, knowledge and interpretive skills may be required; communicate effectively orally and in writing; work overtime as necessary; establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers and members of the public; legally operate a motor vehicle in the State of California.
  
  
Education and Experience: Effective leadership skills, creativity, good decision making and exercising appropriate judgment, the ability to teach, and the ability to lead by example are preferred qualities. Must be at least 18 years of age to apply. Must possess a valid California Driver's License. Completion of high school is required, and some college course work a related field is highly desired.

**SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION**
----------------------------

**SELECTION PROCESS:**

The selection process may include but is not limited to: Application review and evaluation, written examination, performance test and interview. All employment offers made by the City are contingent upon establishing proof of a prospective candidate's legal authorization to work in the United States and successfully passing all components of the pre-employment process. The pre-employment process may include but not be limited to: Reference checks, background investigation, fingerprint-based criminal history check, credit check, degree verification, and post-offer medical examination and drug test. For public safety positions, including positions based in the Police and/or Fire Department(s), the pre-employment process may also include but not be limited to a P.O.S.T. compliant background check, polygraph examination, post-offer medical examination and drug test, and post-offer psychological examination.

Candidates must fill out the employment application and supplemental questions completely and accurately. Required fields and supplemental questions are noted with an asterisk (\*). All other fields are optional. Applications including references to "see resume" are considered incomplete and will be disqualified.

The City of Redondo Beach is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The City will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and encourages both prospective and current employees to discuss potential accommodations with the employer. Candidates with a disability who may need accommodation during the selection process must notify the Human Resources Department at least five (5) business days in advance of the test date.

jobs.description:

We are committed to increasing access to patient-centric, affordable, and high-quality healthcare; your personal contributions are integral to MemorialCare's recognition as a market leader and innovator in value-based and other care models.

Across our family of medical centers, we support each one of our bright, talented employees in reaching the highest levels of professional development, contribution, collaboration, and accountability. Whatever your role and whatever expertise you bring, we are dedicated to helping you achieve your full potential in an environment of respect, innovation, and teamwork.

**Position Summary**

Supports development, implementation, coordination, and evaluation of Memorial Heart and Vascular Institute (MHVI) programs and services. Coordinates patient pathways, multidisciplinary team activities, registry and accreditation requirements, program performance reporting, physician collaboration, and operational initiatives that support program growth, quality outcomes, and regulatory compliance. * Supports program performance improvement activities through monitoring of metrics, tracking action plans, and facilitating follow-up activities.
* Serves as a liaison among patients, families, physicians, departments, and external stakeholders to support communication, problem resolution, and program objectives.

* *Placement in the pay range is based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant years of experience and qualifications. jobs.title: Graduate Program Coordinator, Mathematics, Philosophy, and Physics
jobs.description:
The Schmid College of Science and Technology (SCST) seeks a highly motivated individual to coordinate the graduate program in Math, Philosophy and Physics (MPP). SCST embodies Chapman’s mission of providing students with personalized educational experiences by fostering an outstanding community of teacher-scholars across a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs. The MPP Doctor of Science program recruited the first cohort of students in Fall 2023. By working closely with the program director, leadership, and campus partners, the coordinator will provide administrative support and support a wide range of activities from recruitment through graduation, advising, outreach, orientation, and academic program support. The coordinator implements all activities to ensure enrollment goals are met, engages with students to support their success, and evaluates the continued success of the program. This role requires the individual to be a self-starter and proactive with the ability to coordinate and execute projects both on their own and within a team environment. This position will also collaborate with the existing graduate programs in Schmid College.

Responsibilities

**Recruitment, Admission and Registration Support**

* Serve as liaison to the Office of Graduate Admission, Graduate Financial Aid, Registrar, and Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Education
* Provide administrative support for annual updates to MPP’s graduate handbook, materials, recruitment and admission
* Support recruitment efforts by proactively seeking out prospective students, track, and addressing all inquiries
* Track application materials and review for completeness, coordinate final reviews with the admissions committee, and communicate admission decisions in coordination with the Office of Graduate Admission
* Provide support for information sessions, conferences, and graduate fairs
* Track and maintain scholarships, tuition support and assistantships; prepare reports and apprise the director of the status
  

  

**Student and program support**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for current students, providing guidance on program policies, procedures, and requirements from admission through graduation; respond to student questions and concerns and refer to campus resources as appropriate
* Monitor student compliance with program requirements and track progression towards degree completion
* Collect data, summarize information, and prepare reports to support accreditation, assessment, program review, and updates to program requirements; monitor R2PC (recruit, retain, progress, complete) data and report to the Office of the Vice Provost for Graduate Education
* Prepare and maintain class schedules, textbook requirements, syllabi, part-time faculty contracts, catalog copy, and handbooks in collaboration with the Program Director
* Coordinate logistics for program events and activities such as orientation, seminars, guest speakers, receptions, and networking opportunities; prepare and process speaker agreements and related contracts
* Partner with the program director, leadership, and campus partners to identify student needs and establish support resources
* Participate and represent Schmid in university committees, programs, and events both on and off campus
* Orient new faculty and students to the program and university
* Coordinate maintenance of accurate student, alumni and faculty records including placement, degree progress, and demographic information
* Monitor program expenditures and provide financial reports to Program Director
* Prepare purchase orders and student expense reimbursements on behalf of the director, students and faculty; ensures compliance with university policy
* Coordinate various communications to students, faculty, Dean’s Office and Chapman community through multiple outlets including Canvas, web, email, print and verbal
  

  
Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution of higher education or equivalent combination of education and experience
* A minimum of two years related work experience in providing administrative, program coordination, or student support
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with students, faculty, staff, and campus partners from different backgrounds
* Writing skills to prepare clear and concise, grammatically correct business correspondence; strong editing and proofreading skills.
* Strong technical skills to learn and use enterprise systems needed to track budget, maintain class schedules, process contracts, and admissions records
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of student records and applying federal and state FERPA and Information Privacy Act regulations
* Ability to prioritize work duties when faced with interruptions, distraction and fluctuating workload.
* Ability to exercise good judgment and accomplish tasks in a timely manner.
* Demonstrated organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and maintain composure and good attitude when multi-tasking.
* Ability to schedule and coordinate logistics for meetings and events including coordinating catering, room reservations and set-up.
* Strong working knowledge in the MS Office Suite
* Ability to problem solve and find creative solutions in a fast-paced, student-centered environment

Desired Qualifications

* Knowledge of graduate degree requirements to develop student academic plans and guide/track graduate students through academic planning
* Knowledge of higher education admissions criteria and ability to develop effective results-oriented recruitment strategies

At Chapman University, we believe collaboration thrives through in-person engagement. This position is fully on campus,

jobs.title: ASSISTANT PRODUCTION COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**ASSISTANT PRODUCTION COORDINATOR**

**We Realize Potential in** ***Your*** **Story**  
  
We are a multi-platform production company, social media agency, and digital media network who are currently on a quest to find an **Assistant Production Coordinator** to join our Production team - Is this your next opportunity?

The Assistant Production Coordinator works directly under the Senior Production Manager (PM) to keep the productions and internal logistics running smoothly. They act as a key communication link between set operations, office departments, and outside vendors.

**PERKS OF THE JOB**

**Stay healthy** with a monthly health & wellness stipend and free access to counseling sessions

**Enjoy regular Happy Hours**, treats and events with your team

**Plan ahead** with a 401K retirement fund

**Support your family** with medical, dental & vision insurance

**Invest in your growth** both personally & professionally with our Learning & Development Program

️ **Take flex time off** for vacations, family time, or mental health days

**Enjoy long summer weekends** by working half days on Friday

**HOW YOU WILL SPEND YOUR TIME**

* **Office & Logistics Management:** Run the day-to-day production office, manage office needs, and coordinate meetings, internal support, budgeting , taking notes in meetings and coordinate agendas and daily schedules.
* **Travel & Accommodations:** Book flights, hotels, ground transportation, and process visas or travel itineraries for cast and crew.
* **Vendor & Equipment Coordination:** Assist in sourcing price quotes, placing purchase orders (POs), renting equipment packages, and tracking loss-and-damage (L&D) reports.
* **Paperwork & Compliance:** Handle day-player paperwork, draft production reports, track worker's compensation claims, and manage crew/cast contracts and timecards.
* **Distribution:** Distribute call sheets, scripts, schedule amendments, and daily production paperwork to department heads.

**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED**

Skills matter, experience is useful, attitude is everything.

* **Experience:** Typically 1 to 3+ years of experience in a production office (often stepping up from an Office Production Assistant role).
* **Organization & Time Management:** Exceptional ability to multitask, track tight deadlines, and juggle fast-changing schedules.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills for interfacing with crew, talent, clients and external vendors.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in office software, digital file management (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Suite, Asana, Zoho), and industry-standard production tools (e.g., Hot Budget and Greenslate for Timecards)
* **Soft Skills:** Problem-solving under pressure, working with a small team, assertiveness, leadership, and high stress tolerance.

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, with occasional evenings and weekends for scheduled events  
**Work Setting:** On-site, with travel to event venues as required

A successful event takes careful preparation, good communication and someone who can keep track of the details while plans are coming together. We are hiring an Event Coordinator in Los Angeles to support the planning and delivery of business events, private functions and organized gatherings.

You will work with clients, vendors, venues and internal team members to coordinate arrangements from the early planning stages through event day. The role suits someone who enjoys organizing several tasks at once, follows up on commitments and can respond calmly when schedules or requirements change.

Responsibilities

* Assist with event planning by gathering requirements, confirming objectives and preparing schedules for upcoming functions.
* Coordinate venue arrangements, room layouts, equipment, catering, signage and other event-related requirements.
* Communicate with vendors and service providers to confirm bookings, delivery times, setup instructions and agreed services.
* Maintain event calendars, planning documents, contact lists and task trackers to keep arrangements organized.
* Prepare event timelines and distribute relevant information to staff, suppliers and other participants.
* Track expenses, process purchase requests and maintain records of event-related costs against approved budgets.
* Coordinate registration details, guest lists, invitations and attendee communications where required.
* Visit venues before events to review setup arrangements and identify any outstanding requirements.
* Assist with event-day operations, including supplier arrivals, setup checks, schedule coordination and last-minute adjustments.
* Respond to questions from clients and attendees, directing requests to the appropriate team members.
* Collect feedback after events and help prepare notes on what went well and what could be improved.

Experience And Skills

We are looking for an organized and dependable person who can manage practical arrangements while keeping communication clear. Previous experience in event coordination, hospitality, administration or customer-facing operations would be useful.

The role will benefit from someone who has:

* Good planning skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Confidence communicating with vendors, clients and different internal departments.
* Strong attention to detail when handling schedules, guest information and event documentation.
* The ability to adjust plans when requirements change or unexpected issues arise.
* Basic budget tracking and record-keeping skills.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.

Experience with event planning software, registration platforms or vendor coordination is an advantage. A qualification in Event Management, Hospitality, Communications or Business is welcome, but practical experience and strong organizational ability are also valued.

A Varied Working Environment

The Event Coordinator will divide time between planning tasks, supplier communication, meetings and event preparation. Some assignments may require working at external venues in the Los Angeles area, particularly during setup and live events. Occasional evening or weekend availability will therefore be necessary, with event dates and responsibilities communicated in advance whenever possible.

How To Apply

If you are someone who enjoys organizing details, coordinating people and helping events run according to plan, we welcome your application for the Event Coordinator role in Los Angeles.

Pay: $26.00 - $31.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Vision insurance

The selected candidate will serve as a key member of the BT&E leadership team, responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring control accounts that enable critical laboratory operations, modernization efforts, technology investments, and customer-funded development activities. This role works closely with engineering leaders, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), program customers, finance, planning, and functional leadership to ensure successful execution of scope, schedule, and cost commitments.

jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager, ES - NAMER
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  
  
As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.  
  
A day in the life  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
About the team  
Why AWS?  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become  
  
Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, or related discipline, and 2+ years of equivalent work experience

**Location:** Signal Hill, CA – Office & Field Sales  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Pay:** $75,000–$90,000 per year base salary, depending on experience and qualifications, plus performance-based commission.

**About Us**

Castillo Electric Distribution (CED) is a growing electrical wholesale distributor serving electrical contractors throughout Southern California. We provide electrical materials, equipment, and solutions that help contractors keep their projects moving.

Our commitment is simple: **Smarter Technology. Faster Solutions. Superior Customer Service.**

We are seeking an experienced, motivated, and results-driven Sales Representative who can develop new contractor accounts, grow existing customer relationships, and contribute to profitable sales growth.

This combined inside and outside sales position requires strong electrical product knowledge, industry relationships, excellent organizational skills, and a proven ability to generate business. Your activities will be guided by customer needs, business opportunities, and sales priorities.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with customers from our Signal Hill office and visit contractors, job sites, and prospective customers throughout Southern California.

Some days may involve preparing quotations, managing orders, and following up with customers. Other days may involve meeting contractors, identifying upcoming projects, and developing new business opportunities.

* Experience using Odoo or similar ERP/CRM software.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills.

**What Makes This Opportunity Different?**

* **Enjoy variety in your work.** Combine office-based customer service and sales activities with opportunities to meet contractors in person.

Please submit your resume through Indeed, highlighting your electrical distribution experience, contractor relationships, and sales accomplishments.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Operations Program Manager leads complex, cross-functional programs that enable sales teams to operate more effectively and deliver better client outcomes. A significant focus of the role is managing client portfolio alignment and transfers across large sales organizations, while also supporting broader sales operations priorities, including process improvement, performance insights, and program governance. The role translates business needs into clear plans and requirements, brings together the right partners, drives decisions, and ensures solutions are implemented with discipline and measurable results.

**Key responsibilities**

**Client portfolio program management**

* Lead recurring client portfolio realignment in support of the organization’s business banking client segmentation strategy.
* Oversee the portfolio transfer lifecycle, from client population scoping and data sourcing through approvals, assignments, communications, execution, and post-transfer stabilization.
* Develop and manage integrated plans with clear milestones, dependencies, decision points, owners, readiness criteria, and exit criteria for each transfer phase.
* Coordinate business leaders and subject matter experts across sales, data, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, enablement, and technology.
* Oversee the development and validation of transfer populations using agreed inclusion, exclusion, hierarchy, assignment, and ownership rules.
* Partner with data and business teams to reconcile source information, investigate discrepancies, resolve exceptions, and secure required approvals before execution.
* Coordinate transfer files and system updates across applicable platforms, maintaining clear controls, documentation, and contingency plans.
* Develop and coordinate banker readiness activities, including leadership alignment, role clarity, training, job aids, client context, communications, and escalation support.
* Monitor execution and post-transfer issues, drive timely resolution, confirm stabilization, and incorporate lessons learned into future transfer waves.

**Broader sales operations program leadership**

* Manage the intake, evaluation, prioritization, and staging of sales operations requests and enhancements based on business value, risk, effort, capacity, and strategic alignment.
* Lead cross-functional sales operations programs from concept and requirements through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.
* Build program plans, establish governance routines, facilitate decisions, track risks and dependencies, and provide clear status updates to business and executive leaders.
* Design and implement practical process improvements that simplify work, strengthen controls, improve data quality, and create a more consistent experience for bankers and clients.
* Partner with sales leaders and frontline teams to identify operational needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve banker productivity and sales execution.

**Analytics and business insights**

* Define business questions, key performance indicators, measures of success, and reporting requirements for sales programs and operational processes.
* Partner with data and reporting teams to develop dashboards, recurring reports, and actionable insights for sales and business leaders.
* Analyze performance, adoption, operational trends, exceptions, and root causes to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Translate complex data and findings into clear recommendations, decisions, and actions for leadership.

**Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, process improvement, sales operations, sales enablement, banking operations, or a related client-focused environment.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives involving business teams and partners across data, technology, finance, risk, compliance, operations, communications, or sales.

  
**Preferred Skills/Experience**

* Strong program-management skills, including planning, governance, requirements, issue and risk management, decision tracking, readiness, and implementation.
* Ability to analyze processes and data, identify root causes, develop recommendations, and translate findings into practical business actions.
* Experience gathering business requirements and partnering with technical or data teams through design, testing, implementation, and stabilization.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills, including the ability to create clarity, build alignment, and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex information for executives, sales leaders, bankers, and technical partners.
* Strong judgment, organization, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against firm deadlines.

Preferred

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

Fashion Nova is the world's leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.

Founder & CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online – powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.

Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!

The brand's name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Fashion Nova is seeking a Social Media Manager to lead day-to-day social strategy, creative development, and channel execution across the brand's social platforms.  
Reporting to the Director of Social Media, this role will manage a team of four Social Media Specialists and play a key role in translating Fashion Nova's broader social strategy into distinctive, culturally relevant content and campaigns.

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the content calendar. This person should have a strong creative point of view and the ability to build a social campaign from the initial idea through visual direction, platform strategy, programming, and execution.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing a campaign concept, giving creative feedback, identifying an emerging TikTok behavior, reviewing performance data, and leading a team through a high-volume publishing schedule.

  

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

This role sits at the intersection of social strategy, creative thinking, culture, and team leadership.

We are looking for someone who sees social as a creative medium rather than a distribution channel. Someone who has taste, understands what makes people stop, watch, share, comment, and participate, and knows how to turn a strong idea into a full social campaign.

The right person should be able to look at a product launch or business objective and ask, "What is the social idea?" Then build the creative and strategic framework that brings that idea to life across channels.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* + Manage and develop a team of four Social Media Specialists, providing clear direction, feedback, prioritization, and day-to-day leadership.
  + Translate the Director of Social Media's broader strategy into channel plans, campaigns, programming, and daily execution.
  + Develop distinctive social-first campaign concepts for product launches, collections, cultural moments, partnerships, promotions, and major brand initiatives.
  + Build campaigns with a clear central idea, visual direction, tone, storytelling approach, and platform-specific execution.
  + Bring a strong creative point of view to social, helping shape how Fashion Nova looks, sounds, and behaves across platforms.
  + Partner closely with Creative, Content, Studio, Influencer Marketing, Brand Marketing, E-commerce, and other teams to turn business priorities into compelling social ideas.
  + Lead social brainstorming and concept development, pushing the team beyond expected executions and identifying new formats, storytelling devices, and creative approaches.
  + Oversee content calendars and publishing across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, and emerging platforms.
  + Establish clear briefs for Social Media Specialists, creators, editors, and cross-functional partners.
  + Review content before publishing and provide actionable feedback on concepts, copy, editing, pacing, visual direction, and platform relevance.
  + Identify cultural conversations, memes, platform behaviors, emerging creators, trends, and real-time opportunities relevant to Fashion Nova.
  + Balance planned campaigns with reactive social content, ensuring Fashion Nova moves at the speed of culture without losing its brand identity.
  + Develop platform-specific programming rather than treating every social channel as an extension of the same content calendar.
  + Work with the Director of Social Media to establish content franchises, recurring series, tentpole moments, and experimentation across channels.
  + Monitor social performance across reach, views, engagement, shares, saves, audience growth, traffic, and conversion.
  + Use performance data to identify what is working, what should change, and where the team should test new creative approaches.
  + Present social performance, creative learnings, cultural insights, and recommendations to the Director of Social Media and broader Marketing team.
  + Improve workflows across planning, briefing, approvals, production, publishing, and reporting to support Fashion Nova's high-volume content needs.
  + Maintain consistency across brand voice and visual identity while ensuring each platform feels native to its audience and culture.
  + Support community strategy and social response during major launches, cultural moments, and high-visibility conversations.
  + Stay current on platform changes, creator behavior, internet culture, emerging technologies, AI tools, and new social formats.

**ROLE REQUIREMENTS**

* + 5–7+ years of experience in social media, content, or digital marketing, preferably within fashion, beauty, retail, entertainment, or another fast-moving consumer brand.
  + 2+ years of experience managing or directly leading social media team members.
  + Demonstrated experience developing social campaigns f

**Sales Representative – Altadena Fire Rebuilds (Residential Construction)**  
**Pacific Prestige Properties Inc. | Eagle Rock, Los Angeles, CA**

Pacific Prestige Properties Inc. is looking for an experienced, motivated **Sales Representative** to help Altadena families rebuild their homes after the Eaton Fire. We are actively working on ground-up rebuilds in Altadena. This role reaches out to homeowners who have pulled or applied for rebuild permits and guides them from the first phone call to a signed contract and a finished home.

This is more than a sales job. Many of these homeowners lost everything. They are dealing with insurance claims, permits, architects and a lot of uncertainty. We need someone who knows construction, listens with patience and empathy, and can earn trust by being honest, organized and dependable. You will be calling people on a hard road, and how you treat them matters as much as closing the deal.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Outreach & Lead Development*

* Make high-volume outbound calls to homeowners who have pulled or applied for rebuild permits in Altadena and nearby fire-affected areas.
* Research permit records and keep the lead list organized, accurate and current in our CRM.
* Follow up consistently by phone, email and text, and set in-person or virtual consultations.
* Build referral relationships with architects, designers, insurance adjusters, public adjusters, lenders and community groups involved in the rebuild.
* Represent the company at community meetings, rebuild workshops and local events.

*Consultation & Sales*

* Run consultations that cover each family's goals, timeline, insurance situation and budget.
* Explain the rebuild process clearly: plans, permitting, scheduling, materials and costs.
* Present proposals for full rebuilds, ADUs and related scopes, then negotiate and close contracts.
* Help homeowners make the most of their insurance proceeds and budget with realistic, cost-effective solutions.
* Keep homeowners informed throughout the sales and construction process.

*Design & Materials*

* Help clients choose layouts, finishes, colors and materials.
* Recommend fire-resistant materials and construction methods that meet current code and wildfire requirements.
* Balance quality, look, durability and cost while respecting each family's taste and budget.
* Work with architects, designers, engineers and vendors as needed.

*Construction Knowledge & Cost Management*

* Understand ground-up residential construction methods, materials, labor costs and timelines.
* Write clear, detailed scopes of work and spot extra costs or challenges early.
* Understand construction pricing, budgeting and project profitability.
* Keep every proposal realistic, financially responsible and within the client's budget.

*Project Coordination & Oversight*

* Stay involved after the sale so the handoff from planning to construction goes smoothly.
* Coordinate with project managers, subcontractors and our production team on scope, quality and schedule.
* Keep clients updated on progress, changes and expectations.
* Own client satisfaction an

**What We're Looking For**  
We want someone who combines construction knowledge, sales skill and real care for the people we serve. You know how to listen, understand what a family needs and turn that into a realistic plan to rebuild their home. Our goal at Pacific Prestige Properties is to help Altadena come back stronger and to give every family a transparent, professional and well-managed rebuild from start to finish.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

As a **Customer Success Manager 1** at SmartFinancial, you’ll play a key role in helping insurance agents and agencies succeed on our platform. You’ll manage a growing book of business, build strong client relationships, and work directly with customers to help them maximize the value and performance of their accounts.

You’ll work with smaller accounts, re-engage customers through our win-back dialer, and identify opportunities to grow accounts to higher monthly spending levels.

Our goal is to become the premier Customer Success Team in the Insurtech industry, and you will be an important part of making that happen.

* **Drive Results:** Help customers improve key performance indicators such as cost per acquisition, close rate, lead quality, return on investment, and overall account performance.
* **Retain:** Build trusted customer relationships and proactively identify issues that could impact customer satisfaction, utilization, or retention.
* **Own It:** Serve as a reliable point of contact for your assigned customers, providing consistent communication and helping them achieve their business goals.
* **Solve:** Address customer questions, objections, concerns, and ad-related complaints using established Customer Success processes and protocols.
* **Excel:** Deliver a best-in-class customer experience while consistently achieving the activity, retention, talk-time, and account-growth goals associated with the role.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **1–2+ years of experience** in customer service, customer success, sales, account management, or a related client-facing role preferred.

**This Program Specialist (HR Liaison) serves regional employees and various Stafford Act Disaster employees across multiple locations. They will also have experience guiding staff on human resources related policies, and procedures.**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

This position is announced under FEMA's Excepted Service, Stafford Act Hiring Authority for a full-time Cadre of On-Call Response/Recovery Employee (CORE) appointment. After three years of continuous service, CORE employees earn competitive eligibility to apply for permanent full-time positions at FEMA. Veterans Preference does not apply to the CORE selection process.

  

**Duties**
----------

**What will I do in this position if hired?**

In this Program Specialist position, you will serve a Human Resources Liaison for the Employee Services Branch.
  
  
Typical assignments include:

* **Coordinating staffing, recruitment, employee relations, and personnel actions across disaster workforces.**
* **Maintaining essential Employee Services Branch functions, including employee records management, personnel-status reporting, and organizational chart updates.**
* **Providing assistance, guidance, and training to employees regarding applicable federal policies, regulations, and procedures.**
* **Analyzing human capital data to generate workforce reports, support workforce planning and decision-making, and maintain deployment readiness.**

**What else do I need to know?**

**At FEMA, our mission is to help people before, during and after disasters, and every employee at FEMA has a role in emergency management.** Every FEMA employee has regular and recurring emergency management responsibilities, though not every position requires routine deployment to disaster sites. All positions are subject to recall around the clock for emergency management operations, which may require irregular work hours, work at locations other than the official duty station, and may include duties other than those specified in the employee's official position description. Travel requirements in support of emergency operations may be extensive in nature (weeks to months), with little advance notice, and may require employees to relocate to emergency sites with physically austere and operationally challenging conditions.

**This announcement is for a position as a CORE (Cadre of On-Call Response/Recovery Employee).** CORE employees are full-time employees hired to directly support the response and recovery efforts related to disasters. Employees are hired under the Robert T. Stafford Act and are excluded from the provisions of title 5, United States Code, governing jobs in the competitive service. They can be hired under a streamlined process instead of a competitive process. After three years of continuous service, Stafford Act employees may be granted competitive eligibility to apply for permanent full-time positions at FEMA.
  
  
**This position has promotion potential to the IC-0301-12**. Promotions are dependent on your ability to perform the duties at a higher level, successful performance review displaying at least one year of experience at the lower grade, the continuing need for an employee assigned to the higher level, and management approval.

jobs.description:
**Generic Scope:**

Experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems / issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.

  

**Custom Scope:**

The Ambulatory Care Administrative Coordinator 3 serves as a lead administrative resource and operational partner for assigned ambulatory sub-specialty clinics. Under the supervision and direction of departmental administrative leadership, the incumbent applies broad knowledge of ambulatory care clinical and business operations to support effective clinic management, efficient administrative workflows, provider needs, and consistently exceptional patient experience.

  

The incumbent assumes responsibility for the day-to-day administrative coordination and oversight of assigned clinic workflows, serving as a knowledgeable resource and providing guidance and training to new staff and those providing cross-coverage. This includes ensuring staff understand and consistently follow established scheduling practices, administrative procedures, and workflows that appropriately support patient and provider needs.

  

The position requires a proactive and solutions-oriented individual who takes initiative in identifying operational challenges, evaluating existing processes, and recognizing opportunities to improve clinic efficiency, access, and patient experience. The incumbent is expected to independently gather relevant information, assess operational needs, identify potential solutions, and develop recommendations for review by departmental administrative leadership. All proposed changes to established workflows, administrative practices, scheduling processes, or clinic operations must be reviewed and approved by departmental administrative leadership before implementation. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring that decisions and operational changes remain aligned with departmental priorities, leadership direction, and established standards.

  

The incumbent works directly with providers and clinic staff to understand operational needs, monitor clinic flow, address administrative challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement. This includes coordinating and participating in recurring meetings with providers, clinic teams, and departmental administrative leaders to review clinic operations, discuss challenges, evaluate performance, and develop recommendations to improve clinic function and the overall patient experience.

  

The role is responsible for monitoring clinic performance, tracking and evaluating operational metrics, and preparing routine reports and presentations as necessary that communicate clinic activity, identify trends and operational challenges, and support informed decision-making by departmental leadership. The incumbent is expected to translate operational data into meaningful insights that help identify resource needs, access challenges, workflow inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

  

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, accountability, initiative, and the ability to independently manage assigned responsibilities and competing priorities while working within established departmental guidelines and leadership direction. The incumbent is expected to exercise initiative in day-to-day operational coordination and problem-solving while recognizing when issues, recommendations, or proposed changes require escalation, consultation, and approval from departmental administrative leadership. This position does not have independent authority to establish or implement changes to departmental policies, operational standards, or established clinic workflows without prior leadership review and approval.

  

This is a fully on-site position requiring regular work across multiple clinic locations. The incumbent must demonstrate flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to provide consistent administrative oversight, coordination, and support across assigned sub-specialty clinic locations.

  

**Department Overview**

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about cloud technology and helping customers unlock its full potential? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Enterprise Support is looking for a Technical Account Manager to serve as a trusted technical advisor for our enterprise customers. In this role, you will work directly with customers to help them navigate their cloud journey, from migration planning through operational optimization. You will combine deep technical knowledge with strong relationship-building skills to deliver proactive guidance, resolve complex challenges, and ensure customers achieve meaningful business outcomes through AWS. If you are a curious, self-driven problem solver who thrives on making a tangible impact, this is your opportunity to shape how organizations adopt and scale in the cloud.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for one or more enterprise customers, building trusted advisor relationships and providing strategic guidance across the full cloud adoption lifecycle.
* Proactively review customer environments to identify risks, recommend architectural improvements, and promote best practices around security, fault tolerance, performance, cost effectiveness, and operational readiness.
* Lead planned critical enablement events such as product launches, infrastructure migrations, and scaling activities by assessing operational readiness and driving architecture optimizations.
* Collaborate with cross-functional AWS teams—including solutions architects, service engineers, and account managers—to advocate for customer needs, accelerate issue resolution, and surface feature requests to engineering teams.
* Evaluate opportunities to integrate Generative AI and cloud-native solutions into customer strategies, helping them adopt new AWS capabilities that align with their business goals.

  
A day in the life  
Your morning might begin with a proactive architecture review for a customer preparing to scale a critical workload, followed by a deep-dive call where you help an engineering team optimize their deployment pipeline. After lunch, you could be coordinating with AWS service teams to resolve an operational issue, then wrapping up by preparing data-driven insights for an upcoming quarterly business review. Throughout it all, you are the connective thread between your customers and the broader AWS ecosystem, turning technical complexity into clear, actionable guidance.  
  
About the team  
AWS Enterprise Support partners with customers across industries to help them get the most from cloud technology. Our team is committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, sales, and professional services teams to deliver an exceptional support experience. We are focused on helping customers build resilient, secure, and cost-effective architectures while preparing them for the next wave of cloud innovation. If you want to grow your technical expertise, mentor peers, and contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team culture, we would love to hear from you.

------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

jobs.description:
**About Frec**
--------------

Frec is building the modern investment platform for high-net-worth investors. We combine self-directed investing with continuously managed strategies in a single brokerage account, bringing capabilities traditionally delivered through wealth managers directly to our customers.

We see AI as a way to make sophisticated investing more personal and intuitive. The investment infrastructure we’ve already built gives us a foundation to help customers make better decisions without giving up control of their financial lives.

Customers have entrusted us with $1.5 billion in assets, up 4x in the last year. We’re backed by Greylock and have reached this scale with a small team. The people who join now will help build the primary investment platform for a new generation of investors.

**The role**
------------

As an early member of Frec's Investor Experience team, you'll play a critical role in building lasting customer relationships and shaping how we serve investors as we scale.

You'll own the post-onboarding customer relationship, acting as a knowledgeable and trusted point of contact for investors with increasingly sophisticated financial needs. Your goal is to ensure customers understand the value of Frec’s investment strategies, feel confident using our platform, and have an exceptional experience throughout their relationship with Frec.

This role requires investment fluency, analytical thinking, strong relationship management skills, and the ability to make complex financial concepts accessible. You'll help customers understand everything from direct indexing and tax-loss harvesting to long short strategies, portfolio leverage, financing costs, and investment performance.

Beyond working directly with customers, you'll help build the systems, processes, and standards that define how Frec delivers an exceptional investor experience at scale.

**What you'll do**

* Own the post-onboarding customer relationship, building trust and driving long-term engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Help investors understand their portfolios, investment strategies, performance, tax-loss harvesting, fees, and financing costs.
* Investigate complex customer issues, taking ownership from initial discovery through resolution.
* Partner with product, engineering, and brokerage operations to identify root causes, prioritize improvements, and resolve issues.
* Identify early signs of customer dissatisfaction or disengagement and develop strategies to address them.

* Own and improve key customer experience metrics, including NPS, CSAT, customer health, retention, and response times.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation, AI, and better processes.
* Collect and synthesize customer feedback to influence product development and business priorities.
* Partner with sales and marketing to create a seamless experience across the entire customer journey.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 4+ years of experience in wealth management, brokerage, fintech, customer success, or a related client-facing financial services role.
* SIE, Series 7, and either Series 65 or Series 66 credentials in good standing.
* Strong understanding of financial markets, investment products, brokerage accounts, margin, leverage, and financing costs.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with sophisticated investors.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and meticulous attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM and customer engagement platforms, such as HubSpot.
* A proactive, ownership-oriented approach. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, investigating problems independently, and building processes where they don't yet exist.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base salary with performance-based bonus opportunities
* Meaningful equity ownership in a fast-growing company
* Fully covered health and dental insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Monthly wellness stipend to support physical and mental health
* Flexible paid time off
* Daily in office lunch
* The opportunity to build and shape a core function at an early-stage fintech company

Startup experience as well as familiarity with direct index and tax loss harvesting concepts is a plus! If you’ve worked in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement listed.

Must be able to work on-site 4 days/week from either NYC or SF

Compensation Range: $130K - $170K

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**

Family & Child Empowerment Services (FACES) provides families who live and work in San Francisco with high-quality early childhood education and enrichment; job support, training, and placement; and comprehensive family support services and referrals. Our mission is to empower families who live and work in San Francisco to transform their futures through evidence-based educational and economic opportunities.

**Position Summary**

As the Operations Coordinator, you are an integrity driven person at the center of the day-to-day operations and activities at the Bayview Child Development Center. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and enjoys delivering great customer service in an educational setting. You have a passion for developing efficient systems to support operations and take pride in maintaining a welcoming, organized and safe environment. You are able to find harmony while holding multiple responsibilities and are thorough with everything you accomplish. You are empathetic and deeply committed to equitable service for all the children, families and staff.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide general administrative support with a preference to support the opening shift at the school, receiving and greeting all visitors, taking on complex copying jobs, front desk reception, and routing center mail and deliveries.
* Communicate with school staff, outside agencies, and parents and families to share information, request and provide materials, resolve issues or concerns (via Learning Genie) or other forms of communication.
* Establish and maintain confidential files/records, including student enrollment, attendance, and contact data.
* Complete data entry required for government grant compliance (student attendance, DPH immunization reporting, meal counts).
* With the Site Supervisor’s, schedule and maintain relationships with substitute teacher vendor agencies and manage scheduling and canceling of subs.
* Coordinate and maintain a schedule, with the Site Supervisor’s, for appropriate classroom coverage including managing breaks and transition times.
* Along the Site Supervisor’s, support center safety including leading emergency response drills and monitoring emergency supply inventory.
* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor contractors and vendors for repairs and ongoing maintenance in partnership with the Director of Operations and Facilities.
* Maintain the overall appearance and functionality of the school environment, including decorating for events, keeping bulletin boards updated, and general upkeep of shared spaces such as entrances and the staff lounge, while consistently prioritizing safety.
* Assist with planning, advertising, and hosting student and family events.
* Assist with school-wide communication, including newsletters, flyers, and brochures.
* Manage centralized inventory of supplies and materials and order center supplies as needed.
* In partnership with the enrollment department, assist with new family orientations and enrollment process including scheduling intakes, participating in educating families on center-based systems.
* Work closely with our partners to maintain compliance and complete monthly reports.
* Identify gaps in operations work and develop systems to support efficiency and sustainability

**Minimum Qualifications**:

*You have a solid mix of the following knowledge, ability, skills and experience:*

* 2-3 years of experience working in a bustling, high energy and dynamic collaborative office environment (school-based environment a plus).
* Completion of at least 12 ECE/CD units ("core"courses such as child growth/development, child/family/community, and curriculum)
* Bilingual (Spanish/English) preferred
* Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion in handling confidential materials and matters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to details; ability to work accurately, independently and manage multiple projects effectively.
* Ability to frequently lift a range of weight from ten (10) to forty (40) pounds
* Ability to relate and communicate to individuals from diverse ethnic, cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds and to work with them in a fair, supportive and cooperative manner.
* Proficient in computer navigation, communication, MS Office and client database systems
* Ability to meet and maintain required state, federal, local, and CDC standards (including but not limited to fingerprint clearance, negative TB test, First Aid, CPR)
* A deep commitment to aligning all program practices to FACES values, especially around equity, inclusion, and belonging for all our stakeholder
* Strong passion for and a desire to humbly reflect and grow in pursuit of our mission
* Completion of 6-12 ECE units to assist with ratio in the morning or breaks if needed
* A sense of humor- we believe joy and justice go hand in hand!

**What We Offer**

* Hourly rate range is $36.00-$40.00 based on experience
* Healthcare premiums 100% paid for employees and 25% paid for dependents
* Three weeks of vacation, personal and floating holidays, twelve sick days, ten paid holidays (including one-week winter closure between Christmas and New Year’s) and a day off for your birthday!
* A retirement plan with employer match up to 7% of your salary
* A chance to positively impact the lives of young children and their families
* A fun, dynamic and collaborative working environment
* Opportunity to join a movement to achieve educational, economic, and racial justice!

**FACES is a welcoming space for all. We embrace diversity in all forms- race, gender identity, sexuality, country of origin, religion, or ability. Candidates with diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. FACES is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.**

Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist II will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Six months of related experience is preferred but not required.
* Employees must be approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP) at time of hire or within six months of date of hire.
* Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $19.62/hour + Industry-Leading Benefits for all full-time employees.

**Description:**

  

**Position Summary:** Under the leadership of the Senior Director of Strategic Initiatives, Family and Community Empowerment (FACE), the Program and Operational Strategy Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the effective implementation, coordination, and continuous improvement of FACE workflows and strategies, including supporting high quality and timely execution of strategic initiatives across NYC Public Schools.

  

This position is responsible for leading and coordinating key program management and operational functions, including project planning, execution, and monitoring across a complex, multi-stakeholder environment. The Specialist will support strategic planning and day-to-day operations by ensuring alignment across internal teams, City agencies, and external partners, while strengthening systems that promote effective service delivery.

  

The Specialist will manage project workflows, support cross-functional initiatives, and contribute to operational systems including procurement, resource planning, and team support functions. This role requires strong judgment, organizational leadership, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, public-facing environment.
