Pace University is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Part-Time Program Coordinator to serve as the main administrative support person in the BiCampus Economics Department. Supporting a department of 250+ majors, 9 full-time faculty, 5 adjunct faculty, and student employees, this part-time role serves as the primary point of contact for callers and visitors to the office.

  

The Part-Time Program Coordinator provides exceptional customer service by responding to phone and email inquiries, coordinating communication between faculty and students, and guiding members of the Pace community on departmental procedures. Additional key responsibilities include drafting departmental communications, managing book orders for faculty, tracking office supply budgets, and coordinating travel assignments. The incumbent interacts heavily with the Bi-Campus Department Chair, Assistant Chair program Directors, faculty, and students seeking guidance or approvals.

  

The ideal candidate possesses strong knowledge of University practices, deep familiarity with departmental procedures, and the ability to handle sensitive situations with a high degree of diplomacy, discretion, and tact.

  

**Position Duties**

* Serves as the primary part-time point of contact for callers and visitors to the Economics Department office.
* Provides excellent customer service in responding to phone and email inquiries while guiding students and Pace community members on departmental procedures.
* Drafts departmental communications, official correspondence, and memorandums.
* Coordinates administrative and human resources documentation for the Chair or Department Head.
* Maintains official office records, including syllabi, exams, faculty data, and general business communications.
* Facilitates communication between students and faculty by taking messages and scheduling appointments as needed.
* Supervises, trains, and monitors the department’s part-time student employees, including reviewing and approving student work hours in the time management system.
* Handles basic budgetary tracking by monitoring the office supplies budget and assisting with annual budget preparation.
* Maintains inventory and orders office supplies within assigned budget constraints.
* Submits and coordinates travel arrangements and expense documentation for faculty.

Exact hours to be determined with supervisor; generally up to 20 hours per week.

* Excellent customer service, interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Ability to work a flexible or set part-time schedule as determined by departmental needs.

### **Description**

At **MMGY Global,** we believe nothing shapes your view of the world like travel. So every day, we share our clients’ stories from a perspective that inspires people to see the world differently. Our personalized service and strategy connect media, consumers and influencers across the globe, taking people to new places and changing their views for the better. At MMGY, we inspire people to go places.

We have an immediate opening for an **Account Coordinator** in our **New York** office.

Go places with us! At **MMGY**, we inspire people to go places through our award-winning representation work, which includes public relations, integrated marketing, travel trade and more. If you are looking for an agency home in **New York** where your career path is our priority, let’s talk. Keeping our executives engaged and fulfilled is just as important as keeping our clients happy. With a specialization in international destinations and tourism boards around the world, we have an exciting roster of clients for which we are seeking a talented **BILINGUAL (ENGLISH/SPANISH) ACCOUNT COORDINATOR** who has a passion for travel. If you are outgoing, innovative, eager to grow and resourceful then this job is for you.

We are seeking a motivated professional with 1–2 years of experience in public relations, marketing or travel trade to support our international tourism clients. The role involves coordinating and implementing programs across **travel trade engagement, integrated marketing, public relations, events and project management**, working closely with clients, industry partners and internal teams.

### **Duties will include:**

* Provide day-to-day account support, including market intelligence, project briefs, media monitoring, client reporting and administrative coordination.
* Support the execution of integrated public relations, marketing and travel trade programs for destination and hospitality clients.
* Draft and edit press releases, media pitches, talking points and other communications materials.
* Conduct media outreach, respond to journalist inquiries and coordinate interview and travel requests.
* Maintain media databases, monitor coverage, prepare clipping reports and track PR results.
* Coordinate media familiarization trips, including itinerary development, journalist recruitment and in-destination hosting.
* Support travel trade engagement, including tour operator and travel advisor partnerships, training programs, trade shows and familiarization trips, as needed.
* Assist with the planning and execution of media events, promotional activations and special projects.
* Manage project timelines, deliverables, budgets, and follow-up with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
* Coordinate marketing materials, presentations, campaign assets and partner deliverables.
* Prepare activity reports and track results across PR, marketing and travel trade initiatives.
* Collaborate with account teams to develop creative story angles, campaign ideas and client opportunities.
* Domestic and international travel may be required.

### **Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of experience in public relations, marketing, travel trade, communications or project coordination.
* Experience in the tourism, travel or hospitality industry highly preferred.

jobs.title: Video Production Coordinator (Consultant)
jobs.description:
As the leading global type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy organization, Breakthrough T1D helps make everyday life with T1D better while driving toward cures. We invest in the most promising research to turn ideas into life-changing therapies and devices. We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community - breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. We provide resources and guidance that makes it easier to live and thrive with T1D. This is more than a moment - we're empowering a movement for the T1D community. Share your support and help educate and empower individuals facing type 1 diabetes.

Our mission is to improve lives today and tomorrow by accelerating life changing breakthroughs to treat, prevent and ultimately, cure T1D and its complications. **Always, we are guided by a single purpose: As we drive towards curing type 1 diabetes, we help make everyday life better for the people who face it** .

**Position Summary**

  

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Multimedia and Digital Content, you assist with behind the scenes video work: the person who helps turn a request into a finished, on-brand video, on schedule. You support the intake of video requests, coordination of in-studio, remote, and on-location shoot, and keep scripts, reviews, approvals, and deliverables moving. You also support post-production and keep our video assets organized and easy to find. Working across Marketing, Development, Advocacy, Research, Medical Affairs, Chapters, and Events, you help ensure every video reflects one consistent Breakthrough T1D brand and supports our overall marketing strategy.

  

**As part of this position, you will:**

* Support in-house studio, remote, and on-location productions, including setup, filming support, and wrap.

* Handle scheduling and logistics for on-site and remote shoots, including talent and stakeholder coordination, locations, equipment, run-of-show, and travel.

* Gather and organize the source content each project needs, such as photos, footage, data, quotes, and approved messaging.

* Assist with post-production, including ensuring final delivery in the formats each channel requires, and cataloging of finished and raw digital assets so they can be found and reused.

* Perform quality control on all final deliverables, checking accuracy, brand and style consistency, audio and visual quality, captions, and accessibility before anything is released.

* Operate professional video equipment for in-office filming.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep video content consistent with Breakthrough T1D brand guidelines and aligned with our overall marketing strategy.

* Travel to film off-site as needed. Travel is occasional.

Perform other video production duties as assigned.  

  

How You’ll Spend Your Time

**Time**

**60%**

**Production Support and Logistics**

Supporting studio, remote, and on-location shoots; scheduling talent, locations, and equipment; operating video equipment; and travel as needed.

**40%**

**Post-Production, Quality Control, and Asset Management**

Assisting with editing and delivery, quality-checking final deliverables, and cataloging digital assets.

Engagement Details

* **Structure:** Independent contractor engagement. Hours are approximately 40 horus per week, with flexibility based on project load.

* **Schedule:** In the New York City office as needed based on production schedule. Remaining hours are remote.

* **Travel:** Availability to film off-site is required. Travel is occasional.

  

**You’re Good At**

* **Organization and prioritization:** You keep many projects moving at once, set realistic timelines, and hold stakeholders to them without losing goodwill.

* **Attention to detail:** You catch the details others miss, from a misspelled name on a lower third to a missing caption or an off-brand color.

* **Production logistics:** You coordinate people, locations, equipment, and schedules so that shoot days run smoothly.

* **Collaboration:** You work easily with colleagues across departments, take feedback in stride, and consolidate competing input into clear direction.

* **Composure under deadlines:** You stay calm and solution-oriented when a schedule shifts or a shoot day does not go as planned.

  

**You Bring (Qualifications** )

* 2 or more years of relevant experience in video production, production coordination, or a related role, in-house or agency-side.

* Hands-on experience supporting studio, remote, and on-location shoots, including scheduling and logistics.

* Experience operating professional video equipment such as cameras, lighting, and audio.

* Working knowledge of video editing and post-production workflows, and the ability to support an editor with delivery and file management.

* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests and meet tight deadlines.

* Strong written communication skills, and a high level of attention to detail and quality control.

* Comfort using project management and digital asset management tools.

* Availability to work in the New York City office as needed and to travel occasionally for off-site shoots.

* Experience with scripting and storyboarding is a strong advantage.

* Experience producing video for social media and digital channels, including captioning and accessibility best practices, is a strong advantage.

Salary Range: $55k - $70k

America Works of New York | Midtown, NY

America Works is a pioneer and recognized leader in workforce development. * Team Collaboration: Provide flexible administrative and operational support to management and other departments as needed.

Why Join America Works?

A place to grow your career. America Works is committed to developing its employees and helping them reach their full potential. Many team members who began in entry-level and administrative roles have advanced into management positions, site director roles, grant writing, and other leadership opportunities across the organization.

Learn from experienced professionals. Receive hands-on training and guidance from experienced workforce development professionals while learning an established model for delivering employment services and supporting clients.

Be part of a supportive team. Take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating with experienced colleagues and management who are available to provide guidance and support.

Make a meaningful impact. Your work will directly contribute to creating a welcoming environment, keeping programs running smoothly, and ensuring clients receive the communication and support they need.

Qualifications

* Previous experience in reception, front desk operations, customer service, or administrative support preferred.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and interacting with clients.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work in a fast-paced office environment.

* Professional, approachable, and dependable demeanor.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes initiative, and is comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with direct client interaction. The successful candidate will play an important role in keeping the office organized, supporting program operations, and ensuring clients receive timely and professional assistance.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
Family Health Centers at NYU Langone, a designated Level 3 Medical Home, is the largest federally qualified health center network in New York State, and the second largest in the nation. It includes eight primary care sites, 40 school-based health centers and dental clinics, four day care centers, the nation's largest dental residency program, and New York State's largest behavioral health program. The network also includes 12 community medicine sites providing care to disenfranchised New Yorkers, comprehensive HIV services, chemical dependency programs, and a family support center that offers educational, vocational, and other social support programs. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  
  
Learn more about Family Health Centers at NYU Langone, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X*, *YouTube* *and* *Instagram*.

**Position Summary:**  
We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Coordinator.
  
  
In this role, the successful candidate The mission of the FHC Research Office is to lead and support research studies, evaluations, and data analysis for quality improvement (QI) projects at the Family Health Centers at NYU Langone (FHC). The Family Health Centers at NYU Internal Medicine Residency Program is implementing a federally funded Primary Care Training and Enhancement (PCTE) initiative focused on preparing internal medicine residents to care for medically and socially complex patients, including individuals experiencing homelessness.  
To support these two efforts research and primary care training the FHC is seeking a Research Coordinator. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders and deadlines, and interested in graduate medical education, program evaluation, and academic scholarship.  
The Research Coordinator will be responsible for providing moderate to advanced range of coordination, administration, and project management of research studies and programmatic activities at the FHC. They will work with faculty and staff, residency leadership, chief residents, the Graduate Medical Education office, other departments at the FHC and NYU Langone, and community and clinical partners. They will work under the direction of the FHC Director of Research and the Family Health Centers at NYU Internal Medicine Residency Program Project Director.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Job Responsibilities**  
**Primary Care Training Coordination**  
**Maintain project timelines, task lists, deadlines, and grant deliverables.**  
**Schedule project meetings, document action items, and follow up on outstanding tasks.**  
**Coordinate scheduling and logistics for all PCTE-supported resident rotations, clinical experiences, and community-based activities.**  
**Track resident participation and completion of required PCTE experiences.**  
**Maintain records of grant-supported lectures, trainings, rotations, and other educational activities.**  
**Send reminders to faculty and assist with logistical coordination of educational sessions.**  
**Manage resident and faculty evaluation workflows through the programs electronic evaluation system and follow up on incomplete evaluations.**  
**Maintain and summarize participation, completion, and evaluation data.**  
**Serve as an administrative point of contact for participating faculty, clinical sites, and community partners.**  
**Route site agreements, scopes of work, and other documents for review and signature and track their completion.**  
**Work with the GME office and other institutional departments on administrative requirements related to new or modified rotations and program activities.**  
**Assist the Project Director with preparation of HRSA progress reports and other grant-related reports.**  
**Support dissemination of grant-related work, including literature searches, data summaries, and preparation of initial drafts of abstracts, presentations, and manuscripts for faculty review.**

**Research Coordination**  
**Attend FHC Research Committee meetings and draft follow-up correspondence. Track programmatic progress of research proposals and active studies.**  
**Maintain inventory of research, evaluation, and research-relevant quality improvement (QI) projects. Coordinate with research teams and internal FHC contacts to clarify and update programmatic information about projects and publications. Generate reports for internal and external dissemination.**  
**Track FHC clinician, staff, and residents involvement in research projects and participation in academic and professional conferences.**  
**Assist in the creation of an internal website for the FHC Research Office as part of outreach and dissemination efforts**  
**Support planning and execution of events, such as the Annual Community Research Exchange.**  
**Keep track of conferences or events at which the FHC could present research and QI-research.**  
**Support selected FHC-based research studies in research planning, recruitment, data collection, analysis, and writing. This includes:**  
**Assist with IRB submissions and regulatory documentation**  
**Identify eligible study participants, recruiting, consenting and enrolling subjects into research studies. Conduct informed consent process and ensure study participants comprehension of the research.**  
**Develop research databases and enter research data into study-specific databases as required.**  
**Complete assessments on study subjects/patients following protocol (with proper training)**

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator - Beacon
jobs.description:
University Settlement partners with 40,000+ New Yorkers in Lower Manhattan and Brooklyn every year to build on our collective strengths as we achieve healthy, stable, and remarkable lives. For nearly 140 years, we’ve fought poverty and systemic inequality by building highly effective social services in collaboration with our neighbors. Established in 1886 as the first Settlement House in the United States, we bring the values of that movement into the 21st century by meeting New Yorkers where they live, listening deeply to all perspectives, and creating space for responsive cooperation.

Joining with our neighbors to make stable foundations where people of all ages can grow and pursue their dreams, we build community strength. We infuse a commitment to civic engagement, equality, and communal action into each of our programs, which include early childhood education, youth development, healthy aging, mental health and wellness, English classes for adult immigrants, community centers, and the arts.

The Outreach Coordinator ensures effective outreach to hard-to-reach youth and young adults who do not participate in afterschool or community center programs. The outreach function requires a sensitive individual with the skills and personality to forge relationships with youth who are chronically absent or have dropped out of school and persuade them to engage in Beacon programming. The Outreach Coordinator acts as a “credible messenger” with strong community connections, a good grasp of neighborhood dynamics and ability to address conflicts that have potential to undermine community cohesion. They also have the experience, skills and personal qualities to function as mentors to youth and young adults they enroll in the Beacon. Their priority will be to facilitate a respectful relationship between all community members in the East Village/ Lower East Side and increase Beacon evening and weekend program participation.

The Outreach Coordinator will also plan and facilitate community-building and enrichment activities for at-risk youth . Here, the Outreach Coordinator will be responsible for creating dynamic, engaging, experiential programming for Beacon participants. They will work with Beacon Activity Specialists, Group Leaders, and the Beacon Program Director to create activities in the areas of, but not limited to, the Arts; including Performing and Visual, Recreation/Sports, and Community/Team Building. The Outreach Coordinator will also work with other service providers, both internal and external, to create programming that reflects University Settlement’s core values and mission.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist other Activity Specialists with providing general supervision of Beacon office and shared space.
* Provide a welcoming, professional demeanor to participants and visitors to the program.
* Collect basic information pertaining to young people’s needs.
* Plan and facilitate enrichment activities for Wednesday to Friday night programming.
* Facilitate large and small discussion groups and other activities to foster a sense of community.
* Strategize and achieve enrollment goals as specified by Beacon Program Director.
* Ensure youth receive referrals to appropriate University Settlement programs as well as to other community resources.
* Engage in community conversations/networking with other stake holders (i.e. school leadership team, service providers, school safety).
* Maintain all agency reporting requirements and inform supervisor of all program activities and changes.
* Meet weekly with Supervisor for planning and evaluation.
* Participate in agency-wide initiatives as required by supervisor.
* Complete other relevant duties as requested by supervisor.

**Qualifications:**

* Highschool diploma or HSE required. Knowledge of youth issues and/or familiarity working with at-risk, street involved, or LGBT youth population.
* Demonstrated experience with group facilitation.
* Knowledge of youth empowerment philosophy and harm reduction.
* Training in de-escalation/ conflict mediation helpful.
* Ability to apply positive youth development principles.
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries between self and youth.
* Commitment to professionalism and ability to serve as a staff representative of University Settlement.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills required.
* Self-starter able to work independently.

**Work Schedule:** Full time, Monday - Friday, some evening hours, 35 hours per week, Hybrid schedule

**About Rippling**

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500)

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are Rippling’s sherpas – both for our customers and colleagues. We bring our customers along on the journey as we rapidly enhance and expand the first-of-a-kind employee management platform. We’re looking for a self-driven, growth-minded account manager with a proven track record of success to join our hybrid-remote US-based Account Management team.

You are the primary relationship owner for each of your customers to guide them in optimizing the use of Rippling’s suite of back-office HR products and solutions. You will navigate complex customer issues and priorities and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth. Account Managers in our Mid-Market segment own revenue retention and growth of our largest customers.

This role must be based in the office: San Francisco, New York, Austin.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Ensure our customers in the Partner Referred channel are realizing value and expanding across the platform.
* Proactively engage customers in your book via key lifecycle events: “go live”, benefits renewal, executive business reviews, contract renewal, etc.
* You will field customer requests and lead initiatives in your book to meet company objectives for customer adoption, retention, and revenue growth.
* Consult with clients to understand their HR, IT, Finance, and global workforce management needs through a solutions-based selling approach.
* Navigate a sales process by building relationships with multiple stakeholders through remote meetings.
* Negotiate and coordinate customer procurement and contract execution
* Build and manage a pipeline of new subscription cross-sales, product upgrades, and contract renewals to quarterly targets.
* Develop and demonstrate a broad knowledge of current and new Rippling products via executing customer adoption playbooks and prospecting.
* Partner with your Technical Account Manager to devise account plans, long-term goals, and client strategies; and with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success and secure long-term commitments.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 3+ years of SaaS experience in account management, sales, or quota-carrying customer success
* Track record of consistently meeting and exceeding quota via new product sales and upgrades (license expansion sales are not likely relevant)
* Competitive and creative drive to win over customers and think outside the box to get a deal done
* Demonstrated ability to run a sales discovery and demo meeting and run a structured sales process
* Proven success building and maintaining long-term commercial relationships (experience managing multi-year renewals)
* Highly effective communicator with good people instincts – able to build trust and work well with a diverse group inside and outside the company
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and detail-oriented; great follow-through on projects/tasks big and small
* High integrity; enthusiastic about building a great company for the long term
* PEO or HCM experience a plus, but not required

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com.

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a 40 mile radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive On-Target Earnings (base salary + sales commission) + benefits + equity. The On-Target Earnings\* US-based employees will be 60/40 commission split for base/variable pay for the range listed below.

A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.

* Commission is not guaranteed

170,000 - 170,000 USD per year(US)

Summary
  
  
At Apple, we focus deeply on our customers’ experience. Apple Ads brings this same approach to advertising, helping people find exactly what they’re looking for and helping advertisers grow their businesses. Our technology powers ads and sponsorships across Apple Services, including the App Store, Apple News, and MLS Season Pass. Everything we do is designed for trust, connection, and impact: We respect user privacy, integrate advertising thoughtfully into the experience, and deliver value for advertisers of all sizes—from small app developers to big, global brands. Because when advertising is done right, it benefits everyone.
  
  
Description
  
  
We’re looking for a strategic and detail-oriented Account Manager to drive the seamless execution of premium Apple News Ad Sales campaigns, ensuring exceptional client outcomes at every stage. This role spans full-funnel campaign management—from partnering with Client Partners for initial pitch through post-sale analysis. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, and Marketing, to ensure flawless execution and high-touch service. This is an opportunity to join a high-performing team and contribute meaningfully to the continued growth of Apple News. As an Account Manager on the Apple News Ad Sales team, you will:
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in digital advertising or media sales account management, with a focus on brand-led campaigns
* Experience working directly with clients and media agencies, serving as a strategic partner throughout the campaign lifecycle
* High proficiency in media planning, sales, and ad operations systems (e.g., Salesforce, OperativeOne, Freewheel, or similar)
* Excellent written communication skills

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities under deadlines
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with an emphasis on client service and internal collaboration
* Proactive self-starter with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset
* Experience with display and video advertising best practices
* Demonstrated success working across internal teams to develop and execute advertiser campaigns seamlessly Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to use data to inform decisions, optimizations, and upsell opportunities for brand partners
* Ability to work independently and with a team in a fast paced, rapidly-changing environment
* Passion for Apple’s brand and a commitment to upholding editorial standards

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

jobs.title: Retail Design and Construction Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Help shape how a national retail design and construction organization operates. You will unite internal teams and service providers around clear standards, strong governance, and decision-ready information, while advising senior leaders on outcomes, risks, and priorities.

As a Business Operations Lead Manager on the Retail Design and Construction (RD&C) team, you will lead business operations for a multi-billion-dollar retail construction program delivered across the 48 contiguous states. You will bring 50 internal professionals and more than 400 external specialists across three real estate service providers into one operating model. You will set the roadmap for process, governance, technology, data, financial discipline, and staffing, and serve as the senior operations point of accountability for service-provider performance. You will represent RD&C to business leaders and stakeholders across the bank, and partner with other Global Real Estate (GRE) functions worldwide to keep practices consistent. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to build an operations function that becomes a model for the broader organization and the industry.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the operating model and multi-year roadmap for process, governance, technology, data, and staffing.
* Set measurable operating standards, benchmark performance against industry leaders, and drive continuous improvement.
* Standardize design and project management processes and reporting across internal teams and service partners.
* Create one delivery model across the company and multiple service providers — with shared objectives, clear roles, joint planning, and effective issue resolution — to drive frictionless execution across internal and external teams.
* Own service-level agreements and key performance indicators; lead performance reviews, enforce contract requirements, and oversee remediation plans.
* Lead workforce and vendor capacity planning against program demand and present recommendations for leadership approval.
* Partner with Controls Management, Audit, and Compliance to support adherence to internal controls, policies, and contractual obligations; establish governance routines, decision rights, escalation paths, and operating forums with clear documentation of decisions, owners, and actions.
* Lead RD&C's evaluation and adoption of design, construction, and real estate technology; prioritize platform improvements, integrations, and data flows in partnership with JPMC Global Real Estate, Technology, and Service Partner Technology leaders.
* Act as a trusted partner to senior bank leaders and business clients and represent RD&C in executive forums, providing clear updates on outcomes, risks, trade-offs, and decisions needed, supported by executive-ready materials.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team with an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 10+ years of experience in real estate, design and construction, program or project management, or business operations.
* Demonstrated senior leadership of large, complex programs delivered through multiple vendors or service providers.
* Proven success building and governing service-provider partnerships at scale, including performance measures, contract enforcement, and policy adherence.
* Experience creating operating models, governance structures, decision rights, and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
* Strong executive presence and experience advising senior leaders in a matrixed organization with competing priorities.
* Advanced negotiation, conflict management, vendor management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with capital planning, forecasting, financial analysis, investment tracking, or project accounting.
* Ability to translate business needs into prioritized technology features, integrations, data flows, and reporting improvements.
* Technology-native with AI experience and advanced Microsoft Excel skills (including financial analysis and modeling), plus strong PowerPoint and Word skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive materials and leadership of senior forums, with a proven track record of building, leading, and developing inclusive, accountable, and high-performing teams.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's degree in business, construction management, engineering, architecture, or a related field; a master's degree in business administration or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.
* Experience supporting multi-site retail, branch, or other distributed-footprint construction programs.
* Experience evaluating and adopting construction or real estate technology, including construction management platforms, building information modeling, analytics, automation, or artificial intelligence tools.
* Experience working with technology teams on software integrations and application programming.
* Experience improving funding, invoicing, payment, and approval processes in a large organization.
* Experience aligning internal and external teams around clear, measurable outcomes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.

We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfe

jobs.title: Manager, Growth Marketing (Reactivations)
jobs.description:
Green Chef is the #1 Meal Kit for Eating Clean! To support its exciting growth trajectory, we're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to drive revenue growth through strategy, planning and execution on existing and emerging channels with a focus on Reactivations. In addition to direct channel management, this role will forge strong relationships with Global teams and support total budget steering & media mix optimization for Green Chef—continuously auditing the business and market to identify opportunities to improve customer acquisition and retention.

The role reports to the Marketing Director of Green Chef and involves close collaboration with the broader Marketing organization, Finance, Analytics, Brand Creative and Product Marketing. Your efforts will directly impact customer acquisition, brand visibility, and long-term customer profitability for HelloFresh's most premium meal kit offering, proven to help you build healthy habits.

**You will …**

* Lead strategy and execution across select Reactivation channels that aim to drive reach and optimize for quality conversions e.g. Email, SMS, Paid Social, Paid Search, and emerging channels
* Manage external partners and internal collaborators to deliver high-impact campaigns from concept through execution and optimization
* Develop, brief, and review creative assets and messaging in partnership with the Product Marketing Manager, ensuring alignment with brand and performance goals
* With Strategy & Operations + Channel Leads, manage day-to-day steering of total marketing mix to hit KPI targets
* Monitor campaign performance across initiatives, using data and insights to guide optimizations and inform strategic decisions
* Identify and explore new marketing opportunities that align with business goals, serving as a generalist marketer and agile problem-solver
* Regularly audit and identify opportunities within customer retention
* Stay informed on industry trends, competitor strategies, new growth tactics and Gen-AI opportunities to fuel innovation and differentiation

**You are…**

* Creative Problem-Solver: You are resourceful, think outside the box and turn challenges into opportunities and inspiring others to do the same
* Customer-Obsessed: You deeply understand customer needs and turn insights into impactful marketing strategies that drive satisfaction and growth.
* Collaborative: You thrive in a cross-functional environment, cultivating collaborative partnerships at all levels and departments to drive alignment and execution.
* Strategic & Insightful: You develop high-level strategies, guide execution, and solve complex problems with clear logic and contingency planning.
* Results-oriented: You focus on outcomes and are committed to driving meaningful improvements in both acquisition and retention
* Adaptable: You thrive in fast-paced environments and stay flexible in the face of changing priorities, consistently delivering under pressure.

#### **You have…**

* 4–5 years of experience in growth, digital, or performance marketing, preferably at a high-growth consumer brand or agency with a focus on D2C/eCommerce/subscription models
* Demonstrated success managing paid marketing channels and campaigns, with measurable results tied to CAC, ROI or LTV
* Highly organized with strong project management and communication skills; adept at managing multiple priorities and cross-functional teams
* Strong analytical mindset; skilled in Excel/Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards; SQL experience is a plus. You use data to drive decisions—tracking metrics like CAC, CVR, CLV, and retention to continuously improve campaign performance.

**You'll get…**

* Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation
* Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
* Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
* Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
* Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor\_)
* Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
* Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist

**Part-time · 10 hours per week · $18–$19 per hour**

The Law Offices of Oliver C. Minott is hiring a part-time Digital Marketing & Social Media Specialist to **create and manage the firm’s YouTube channel, Facebook Page, Instagram account, and TikTok account**. You’ll help grow the online presence of our workers’ compensation and Social Security Disability practice.

jobs.title: SDR (Sales Development Representative)
jobs.description:
**About Zip Security**
======================

Cybersecurity for growing businesses is broken — even enterprises spend heavily across hundreds of disconnected tools for marginal real-world benefit. For startups and mid-sized firms, this gap often means forgoing security entirely, or cobbling together a solution that leaves them vulnerable in other ways. At Zip Security, we build solutions that make enterprise cybersecurity effective and doable for growing businesses of all kinds, whether or not they have a security team in house.  
  
Our product is a complete security program that automates device management, endpoint security, identity and access management, compliance, and managed IT and security operations to keep teams of all kinds protected. We help our customers pick their right security frameworks, correctly deploy the tools, policies, and controls they need, and keep everything enforced over time, so their business is protected and compliant, 24/7.

Zip is at the cutting edge of what’s possible in cybersecurity, and dedicated to delivering value for our customers. It’s a big part of why we’re backed by Ballistic Ventures. Major platforms are opening APIs that enable automated management at scale, new government initiatives are surfacing global threat data, and we're positioned to be the first to properly integrate all of it. We're looking for driven, talented people to help us get there. If this resonates with you, we invite you to consider building alongside our team.

**About The Role**
==================

As a **Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Zip Security**, you’ll have the opportunity to kick-start your sales career at a rapidly growing cybersecurity startup. Having built our founding cohort of SDRs, we're excited to continue scaling our team with ambitious, hardworking individuals who are eager to learn, challenge themselves, and grow alongside us.

* You're naturally curious, personable, and enjoy connecting with new people.

* You're highly coachable, receptive to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
***Company Description***

*We’re**Checkout.com**. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.*

*We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.*  
  
*Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.*  
  
*If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.*  
  
*With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.*

**The opportunity**
===================

As a **BDR**, you’ll be one of the first voices prospective merchants hear from Checkout.com. You’ll help open thoughtful, relevant conversations with businesses, learn what matters to them, and create qualified opportunities for our sales team.

This is a great next step for someone with **1–2 years of BDR experience** who is hungry to grow a career in sales. You’ll work closely with sales partners, build a strong foundation in payments and merchant needs, and have a direct hand in influencing the pipeline. Payments experience is a plus, but it isn’t required-we’re looking for curiosity, commitment, and the drive to learn.

**What success looks like**
===========================

Within your first six months, you’ll have built strong relationships with your sales partners and be fully ramped on the top-of-funnel process. You’ll confidently manage prospecting and meeting booking, handle high-level cold conversations with prospective merchants, and create qualified opportunities that contribute to pipeline.

**What you’ll do**
==================

* Research prospective merchants and identify relevant reasons to start a conversation.
* Use phone, email, and other appropriate channels to engage prospects and book qualified meetings.
* Lead professional, high-level cold conversations with senior stakeholders, listen for business priorities, and connect them to a relevant next step.
* Partner closely with sales colleagues to align on target accounts, share context, and make smooth, useful meeting handoffs.
* Keep prospect activity, notes, and next steps organized in our systems, and follow through reliably.
* Build your understanding of payments, Checkout.com’s value, and the internal top-of-funnel process.
* Share what you learn from the market to help the team improve its outreach and prospect engagement.

**What you’ll bring**
=====================

* 1–2 years of BDR/SDR-specific experience, with examples of prospecting and meeting generation.
* Confidence and professionalism on the phone, with the ability to adapt your message and ask thoughtful questions.
* Strong written communication and attention to detail.
* A curious, coachable approach and the discipline to learn, prepare, and follow through.
* A relationship-first mindset: you care about understanding a prospect’s world and bringing useful value to the conversation.
* Resilience and commitment in a goal-oriented role, while maintaining a thoughtful, professional approach.
* Payments or fintech experience is preferred, but not required.
* Ability to work from our New York City location.

**Additional Information**

**Bring all of you to work**

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

**Life at** **Checkout.com**

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Compensation Range: $65K - $80K

Before opening day, you'll be the point person for building management, vendors, and move-in readiness, so the first employees walk into a space that works. Provide basic troubleshooting for office equipment and serve as a liaison with IT to coordinate support and escalate technical issues as needed. Partner with internal teams to ensure a positive experience for employees and visitors.

**What you have:**
==================

* 5+ years of experience as an executive assistant, office manager, or workplace coordinator, ideally supporting senior executives at a fast-growing company.
* Experience opening, scaling, or managing an office of 30 to 100 people.

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  
  
As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.  
  
A day in the life  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
About the team  
Why AWS?  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become  
  
Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, or related discipline, and 2+ years of equivalent work experience

The Client Success Manager is responsible for developing and maintaining a strong and lasting client and broker/consultant partnership with assigned customers. This role is engaged in the strategic and proactive planning within the client’s overall line of business and is responsible for identifying and executing opportunities to engage the employee and member population to ultimately drive clinical and savings outcomes. This is accomplished via proactive and timely issue resolution, consulting customers on best practices, reviewing service/product offerings, recommending new solutions and providing market insights.

* Use creative feedback tools to develop an understanding of customer’s needs, work with internal partners to improve products and services.

This role coordinates dock activities, staffing, planning, schedules, equipment utilization, and operational priorities while ensuring compliance with company policies, procedures, safety requirements, and applicable regulations.

None

* Maintain regular attendance and punctuality and perform other duties as assigned.

-------------------------------

*Education/Work Experience/Certificates*

* High school diploma or GED required.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in transportation, logistics, LTL freight, warehouse, distribution, or dock operations preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Excel, and Word, and the ability to learn transportation, warehouse, and operational management systems.
* 1 Year Forklift Experience
* Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record, if driving is required as part of the position.

**Skills**

* Dock and freight operations
* LTL transportation operations
* Staff coordination and scheduling
* Daily operational planning
* Workflow and workload management
* Freight movement coordination
* Trailer and equipment coordination
* Forklift and material-handling equipment awareness
* Safety compliance and hazard prevention
* OSHA and transportation regulatory compliance
* KPI and productivity monitoring
* Operational problem-solving
* Process improvement
* Customer service and communication
* Cross-functional team collaboration
* Employee training and development
* Documentation and recordkeeping
* Computer and operational systems proficiency
* Time management and prioritization
* Organization and attention to detail
* Ability to work in high-volume, fast-paced environments
* Ability to adapt to changing operational priorities
* Leadership and team coordination
* Conflict resolution
* Decision-making and critical thinking
* Knowledge of SC Logic a plus

**Physical Requirements:**
--------------------------

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods while monitoring dock operations.
* Ability to move throughout the dock, warehouse, and service center, including navigating around freight, trailers, and equipment.
* Ability to bend, stoop, reach, climb stairs, and maneuver in an active dock environment as needed.

Under the supervision of the Member Services Outreach Manager, the Outreach Coordinator is responsible for assisting with the planning, development, execution, and evaluation of a comprehensive member education and engagement program designed to enhance the knowledge and understanding of TRS benefits and retirement security in alignment with TRS organizational goals. This position works closely with internal and external stakeholders, including Counseling, Communications, Deferred Compensation, Supplemental Savings Plan Education Specialists, and Employer Services, to support coordinated messaging related to TRS’s mission and vision, TRS benefits, and legislation affecting the System.
  
  
This position requires strong organization, planning, and communication skills and the ability to effectively articulate TRS’s mission, vision, statutory requirements, and retirement benefits. The incumbent must be able to work independently, prioritize and follow through on assignments, and effectively support multiple outreach activities. The incumbent must develop a working knowledge of the Pension Code, Administrative Rules, TRS rules and procedures, and benefits provided through the Teachers’ Retirement Insurance Program (TRIP) and the State of Illinois Group Insurance Program.

**Essential Functions:**

* Assist with the planning, development, execution, and evaluation of member education and outreach programs, including field education, webinars, and other initiatives designed to increase member understanding of TRS benefits and retirement security.
* Deliver presentations and educational programs to members, employers, stakeholder organizations, and other audiences on topics including TRS benefits, retirement security, the Supplemental Savings Plan, legislation, and other System-related topics.
* Assist with the development and coordination of the annual field education schedule and respond to presentation and outreach opportunities.
* Develop and maintain relationships with school districts, teacher organizations, annuitant organizations, school management organizations, and other stakeholders to support educational outreach and engagement.
* Assist with assessing audience and stakeholder needs and tailoring presentations, messaging, and educational resources accordingly.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners, including Counseling, Communications, Deferred Compensation, Supplemental Savings Plan Education Representatives, and Employer Services, to support consistent and coordinated member messaging.
* Assist with evaluating outreach activities through surveys, feedback, participation information, and other measures and communicate opportunities for improvement to the Senior Outreach Coordinator and Member Services Outreach Manager.
* Assist with the development, review, and maintenance of outreach materials, presentations, webinars, and other educational resources.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the Pension Code, Administrative Rules, TRS rules and procedures, TRIP, the State of Illinois Group Insurance Program, legislative activities, and related federal and state programs affecting TRS members.
* Communicate member issues, concerns, and trends to TRS staff and management and provide feedback regarding member and stakeholder needs.
Performs other duties as assigned  

  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Possesses a high degree of initiative
* Excellent interpersonal skills
* Demonstrates a high commitment to quality
* Develops and delivers effective presentations
* Ability to positively represent the organization with external constituents
Ability to organize, prioritize, and follow through on multiple assignments  

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in communication, marketing, public relations, finance education or a related field
* Three (3) year of experiences as a Benefits Counselor or equivalent experience preferred
* This position requires a valid driver's license
* Travel and evening work is required

If you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy collaborating with driven, enthusiastic professionals, you will find a rewarding career with us.

For Illinois job seekers:

**Pay Range**

$77,444.00 - $120,812.00

Compensation will be determined based on the qualifications and experience of each candidate.

TRS is an agency of the State of Illinois. **Development Coordinator**

**Location:** Chicago, IL – W. Diversey & N. Lakeview Ave. (Lincoln Park)
  
**Department:** Elks National Foundation (ENF)
  
**Reports To:** Assistant Director

  

**Who We Are**

The Elks National Foundation (ENF) is the charitable arm of the Benevolent and Protective Order of Elks. Established in 1928, the ENF is a dynamic charitable foundation in the heart of Lincoln Park whose national programs teach youth lifelong skills, inspire the pursuit of knowledge, serve veterans, and transform local communities into healthier and safer places to live.

  

**Why Work with Us**

At the ENF, our employees are our greatest strength. Team members value:

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Directly support charitable programs that change lives.
* **Professional Development:** ENF invests in training, certifications, and opportunities to grow.
* **Supportive Environment:** Collaborative, respectful, and aligned with the Elks’ commitment to service.
* **Historic Setting:** Work inside one of Chicago’s most architecturally significant campuses.

  

**Position Purpose**

The Development Coordinator is a key member of ENF’s fundraising team, supporting both individual donors and fundraising volunteers. Reporting to the Assistant Director, this role assists in executing the ENF fundraising plan, managing volunteer resources, supporting donor stewardship efforts, and assisting with program and event logistics.

  

This position is ideal for a customer-focused problem solver who is thoughtful in communication, detail-oriented, and eager to grow skills in fundraising and donor relations.

  

**Essential Responsibilities**

  

**Fundraising & Administrative Support**

**Volunteer Resources & Collaboration**

**Donor & Volunteer Engagement**

* Respond to inquiries via phone, email, and written correspondence.

**Data & Reporting**

* Perform data entry, data extraction, and routine database maintenance to support daily, weekly, and monthly departmental tasks.

**Education & Experience**

**Required**

* Ability to establish priorities, meet deadlines, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

**Preferred**

**Skills & Competencies**

* Demonstrated poise, tact, and diplomacy when communicating across multiple generations and audiences.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills, including the ability to identify problems and propose solutions.

jobs.description:
**Please note:** A cover letter is required for this application.

**Overview:**

The Development Coordinator serves a critical role within The Americas Architecture Prize and reports directly to the Director of MCHAP. This team member leads and supports the organization’s revenue generation and network of supporters, allies, partners, and participants. The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of and appreciation for the broader architectural field; has a passion for not-for-profit development; is motivated, self-directed, and detail oriented; and works well with others in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

**About Us:**

The Americas Architecture Prize is a newly established 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization that operates the Mies Crown Hall Americas Prize (MCHAP) and related programs, an internationally renowned initiative launched nearly 15 years ago at the Illinois Institute of Technology College of Architecture (now College of Design Futures School of Architecture) in Chicago, Illinois. The new organization establishes autonomous governance of MCHAP, supports sustainable and effective operations, and enables a greater hemispheric exchange. The Americas Architecture Prize maintains a close and mutually beneficial partnership with IIT.

The Americas Architecture Prize annually will have a $750,000 operating budget and a $500,000 fundraising goal.

The Americas Architecture Prize seeks to improve the built environment by highlighting, disseminating, and teaching lessons-learned through observation of new outstanding built projects and their innovative design and construction practices in the Americas. The Americas Architecture Prize researches, selects, and educates about the most distinguished newly built works of architecture in the North and South American continents, including buildings, infrastructure, landscape, and urbanism; seeks to build an international platform that engages students, academics, and professionals making decisions affecting our built world across a diversity of interrelated fields, including design, engineering, construction, finance, public policy, and more; and rewards daring solutions to the pressing challenges of our built environment and awards two biennial prizes – the MCHAP Americas Prize and the MCHAP for Emerging Practice.

The Americas Architecture Prize relies on an international network of esteemed nominators and jurors, corporate sponsors and individual donors, and partner organizations to operate and provide a diverse offering of programming to students, faculty, professionals, and communities throughout the Americas.

**Responsibilities:**

*FUNDRAISING & DEVELOPMENT*

* Establish annual fundraising goals with the Director and Board of Directors. This will include individual, Board, corporate, foundation, government, and special event-based funding opportunities.
* Execute the plan to achieve the goals.
* Develop and keep current the databases of past, current, and potential supporters.
* Cultivate new relationships for potential funding opportunities and build a pipeline of potential donors (individual, corporate, foundation, etc.).
* Develop fundraising proposals, grant applications, and other supporting materials.
* Assist in planning and executing benefit dinners and other funding events.
* Oversee fundraising for special projects, such as video production and publications.
* Support the Director and Board in making fundraising asks.
* Process gifts made directly to the organization, manage donor records, and prepare gift acknowledgments in accordance with accounting standards and best practices.
* Coordinate with Illinois Institute of Technology regarding gifts received through them and opportunities for joint overtures to potential funders.

*RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT*

* Assist in maintaining an accurate and updated network contact database (Copper).
* Manage communications with existing donor, sponsor, and patron relationships and MCHAP participants (e.g., current and past jurors, nominators, nominees, and others).
* Serve as liaison to The Americas Architecture Prize Board of Directors.

**Expectations:**

The Development Coordinator commits to working alongside the entire The Americas Architecture Prize team to support its success. Given the nature of the 2-year prize cycle, including evening or weekend activities, working hours will occasionally be outside a standard 9 to 5 schedule and require flexibility (with ample notice). The individual must be based in the Chicago area, though work-from-home scheduling is available upon approval and coordination with the Director. All organization staff are expected to support and work all events, unless otherwise approved.

**Qualifications:**

*EDUCATION*

* Bachelor’s degree in Nonprofit Management or related field is preferred

*EXPERIENCE*

* Minimum of 3 years of professional work experience in fundraising or nonprofit administration

*PREFERRED TECHNICAL SKILLS*

* Proficiency in donor management software (Copper)
* Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English
* Strong understanding of budget development and management
* Familiarity with grant writing
* Familiarity with event management

*SOFT SKILLS*

* Detail oriented, self-directed, and a team player
* Passion for development and fundraising
* Strong project management skills
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment
* Exceptional interpersonal and networking skills
* Passion for international exchange, especially across the Americas

*ADDITIONAL ASSETS*

* Intermediate written and verbal proficiency in Spanish, French, and/or Portuguese

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

Posting Description:

**Surety Account Manager II**

Are you a surety professional who thrives at the intersection of client service, underwriting strategy, and operational execution? Join a high-performing team and take on a meaningful role managing and delivering surety bond solutions for many clients.

*This role is hybrid and can be located near an Aon office.*

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

You'll work closely with clients, surety carriers, and internal collaborators to deliver bond programs with accuracy, compliance, and outstanding service. This role involves significant client interaction and ownership of key accounts. It offers the chance to create an immediate impact while further developing your expertise in the specialized field of surety.

  

* Works under minimal supervision, exercising good judgment in routine and moderately complex client and market situations.
* Takes primary accountability in managing selected accounts.
* Possesses a working knowledge of surety bonds, including bond program structures, indemnity concepts, and market practices including accurate client interaction and advisement.
* May assist in onboarding, mentoring, and training internal team.
* Works closely with carriers every day to address evolving needs. Prepares and processes various surety instruments, such as bid, final, miscellaneous, and court bonds. Ensures these align with underwriting guidelines and client expectations.
* Collaborates with clients daily to meet their changing requirements. Implements Consents of Surety, Prequalification Letters, Riders, and other obligations required by clients in line with State rules. Determines the necessary documents to complete issuance, including power-of-attorney, resident license, and others, ensuring attention to contractual, legal, and financial details.

* Manages countersignature requirements and related jurisdictional nuances to support compliant bond issuance across multiple states and territories.
* Provides technical surety mentorship and support to non-surety colleagues, helping interpret bond forms, indemnity requirements, and program structures for internal collaborators.
* Coordinates receipt and organization of pertinent client related underwriting information (e.g., financial statements, work-in-progress schedules, bank information, organizational documents) to support timely carrier decisions.
* Verifies that all bonds are issued within established surety lines of credit and brokerage authority. Assists in structuring and negotiating approvals for bond requests exceeding standard limits or outside delegated authority.

**How this opportunity is different**

Unlike many surety operations roles focused mainly on transaction processing, this position combines technical surety expertise with client advisory duties and meaningful market involvement. You will work directly with complex bonding programs, underwriting negotiations, and carrier relationships while acting as a trusted resource for clients and internal colleagues. The role also allows for broader influence through mentoring, participation in process improvement, and responsibility for critical compliance and underwriting workflows. For professionals wanting to move beyond administrative bond issuance and act as a strategic partner in the surety process, this is an outstanding chance to increase visibility, expand impact, and grow within a leading organization.

* Is able to effectively interpret a variety of technical instructions involving abstract and concrete variables and apply them to client and bond-specific scenarios.
* Shows excellent organizational, time-management, and multi-tasking abilities, successfully managing various client and market requirements.
* Retains Notary Public certification.
* Maintains Power of Attorney appointments with major surety markets and exercises such authority responsibly and in accordance with internal controls.
* Is proficient in all required technology platforms, including AonBondLink, Bridge, and Outlook. Uses them to facilitate deliverables for clients and with markets around exposures, new bond needs, changes, expirations, or similar.

**Education and licensing requirements:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred for this position. Maintain Notary Public designation and hold the appropriate Producer license.
