jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager, ES - NAMER
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support, Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  
  
As a TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, Gen/AI, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.  
  
A day in the life  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  
  
About the team  
Why AWS?  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become  
  
Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, or related discipline, and 2+ years of equivalent work experience

jobs.title: Carrier Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Who we are and why we’re hiring
  
CJ Logistics delivers integrated and multimodal logistics services, connecting every corner of the world via air, sea and land. As a lead logistics partner (LLP), third-party logistics provider (3PL) and supply chain consultant, we help customers leverage supply chain management as a competitive advantage, reducing total system costs, transforming business processes, improving service and facilitating growth and change. With a focus on social responsibility and sustainability through growth with customers and communities, we prioritize the wellbeing of the end consumer, our customers and our employees. CJ Logistics is responsible for the North America region, specializing in solutions for regulated industries such as food and beverage, consumer-packaged goods, healthcare and medical supplies, and tire and automotive.
  
  
**Schedule:** M-F, 07:00 am - 4:30 pm CST, + one weekend day every month
  
**Incentive eligible:** No
  
Position Overview
  
The Carrier Sales Representative will be responsible for building and maintaining relationships with carriers, negotiating
  
competitive rates, and ensuring the successful execution of freight movements. Their expertise in carrier management
  
and their ability to provide efficient solutions will play a critical role in the success of our operations.
  
Essential Job Duties & Responsibilities
  

* Carrier Sourcing: Identify and secure reliable carriers to transport freight across various lanes and modes of transportation (FTL, LTL, etc.).
* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with carriers to ensure consistent capacity and service levels.
* Rate Negotiation: Negotiate competitive rates with carriers while maintaining profitability and ensuring customer satisfaction.
* Shipment Coordination: Collaborate with the operations team to ensure timely pickup, transit, and delivery of freight.
* Issue Resolution: Address and resolve any issues or challenges that arise during shipment, including delays, damages, or other concerns.
* Market Research: Monitor market trends, capacity fluctuations, and industry developments to maintain a competitive edge in carrier negotiations.
* Compliance: Ensure carriers meet all safety, insurance, and regulatory requirements.
* Data Management: Accurately maintain carrier profiles, rates, and activity records in the company’s CRM or TMS systems.
* Perform other related job duties as assigned or required.

Required Qualifications
  

* Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in carrier sales, freight brokerage, or logistics.
* Familiarity with FTL, LTL, and intermodal transportation.
* Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business, or related field (preferred).
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with carriers.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficiency in using transportation management systems (TMS) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach.

Physical Requirements
  
This is largely a sedentary role requiring the physical ability to:
  

* Sit for prolonged periods of time at a desk while working on a computer
* Use hands and fingers to operate a keyboard, mouse, and telephone
* Speak and hear clearly in person, virtually, and over the phone
* Occasionally stand, walk, reach, stoop, or lift up to 10 pounds

Work Environment
  
This position operates in a professional office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment, such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and printers.

new_jobs.title: Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Hope Mission Statement**

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

**Position Purpose and Summary**

Interim housing programs run on direct service and leadership. What keeps them running — accurately, compliantly, and without things falling through the cracks — is coordination. The Program Coordinator is responsible for that infrastructure.

Reporting to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager, the Program Coordinator provides the administrative, operational, and data coordination support that enables assigned HTM interim housing sites to function in alignment with agency policies, funder requirements, and contract standards. This role tracks documentation, monitors compliance tasks, maintains participant records in HMIS, reviews shift reports, follows up on incidents, and ensures that the operational details of daily program life are organized, accounted for, and ready for scrutiny. When audits happen, when monitoring visits arrive, when leadership needs to know whether documentation is current — the Program Coordinator is the reason the answer is yes.

This is not a supervisory role, and the distinction is deliberate. The Program Coordinator's value is in coordination, quality control, and follow-through — not authority. It requires someone who can hold a high volume of moving parts with precision and calm, who understands that a missing daily activity report or an untracked incident is not a paperwork problem but a compliance risk, and who takes both the operational and the relational dimensions of the work seriously. Programs do not run on good intentions. They run on systems, and this role is responsible for keeping those systems intact.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

*Data, Documentation & Compliance*

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date participant records in HMIS and other agency-approved data systems
* Track completion of required program documents including Daily Activity Reports (DARs), wellness check logs, incident report submissions, and case management documentation
* Conduct first-level review of documentation for completeness and accuracy; flag missing or late items for follow-up
* Submit and follow up on all incident reports in accordance with agency protocols
* Review shift reports regularly to monitor staff performance and documentation compliance
* Maintain organized participant files, rosters, logs, and trackers in accordance with program and funder requirements
* Assist with preparation for audits, monitoring visits, and internal reviews by gathering and organizing requested documentation
* Support program and contract compliance by regularly reviewing logs, records, and data against funder requirements

*Operations & Site Management*

* Monitor the medication cabinet and review all medication records
* Track supply inventory and submit facility maintenance, IT, and supply order requests with Program Manager approval
* Regularly inspect bathroom facilities, shelter rooms, and site surroundings to ensure clean, sanitary, and safe conditions
* Report maintenance issues and repair needs to the supervisor promptly
* Help train janitorial and hygiene staff on proper site and bathroom maintenance protocols
* Coordinate communication between shifts, departments, and program leadership regarding operational needs and follow-up items
* Provide on-site support during high-volume or high-need operational periods
* Work collaboratively with outsourced security staff to maintain safety for participants, staff, volunteers, and visitors
* Train staff on the use of security and surveillance systems

*Staff Support & Coordination*

* Provide direction and training to shelter support staff including Client Service Monitors and Case Managers in collaboration with the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager
* Maintain staff timesheets and daily activity reports as directed
* Support onboarding processes by coordinating training schedules, tracking credentials, and organizing required documentation
* Schedule meetings, case conferences, and staff training sessions as directed
* Provide staff coverage as needed, including substituting as a Client Service Monitor during absences
* Provide feedback to leadership on service delivery, program enhancements, and operational modifications as needed

*Participant & Community Engagement*

* Assist with participant issues including conflict resolution and complaint resolution using de-escalation and mediation techniques
* Provide emergency service referrals and warm handoffs for domestic violence, human trafficking, sexual assault, and other crisis needs as appropriate
* Ensure implementation of Housing First, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care principles across all participant interactions
* Support participant engagement activities, orientations, and program communications as assigned
* Support case management services to participants as needed
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with community partners including mental health programs, law enforcement, neighborhood councils, and service providers

*General*

* Coordinate external partners, service providers, and volunteers as directed
* Adhere to all organizational policies related to attendance, dress code, professionalism, and conduct
* Identify and report unsafe situations, systems, or processes to supervisors promptly
* Perform other duties as assigned

* Must pass background check as required per worksite

The Redondo Beach Housing Authority administers the Housing Choice Voucher rental assistance program. It also manages specialized programs such as Veterans Affairs Supportive Housing (VASH), Emergency Housing Vouchers (EHV), Project-Based Vouchers, and Foster Youth for Independence (FYI) programs that are funded by the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), which is a branch of the federal government.

  
Under direction of a supervisor, this position is responsible for performing paraprofessional duties and supporting the Housing Division staff with general clerical tasks. The position serves as the first contact for the Housing Division providing outstanding customer service to program participants and the public. Responsibilities also include addressing general inquiries regarding the Housing programs administered by the Housing Division.

---------------------------------------------------------

* Reviews client applications for eligibility of rental assistance
* Monitors and supervises program participants
* Resolves concerns between tenant, landlord, and the Housing Authority
* Confers and collaborates with other social services providers as appropriate
* Collects and reports participant data to HUD
* Operates a motor vehicle in the performance of home inspections
* Conduct HUD NSPIRE inspections
* Performs other related duties as assigned

The Boeing Test & Evaluation (BT&E) organization is seeking a **Control Account Manager (Associate or Mid-Level)** to join our team in **Long Beach, CA**.

BT&E provides enterprise test capabilities supporting multiple Boeing commercial, defense, and government programs. This position will support Southern California Aeronautical System Integration & Test (ASIT) laboratories, including System Integration Laboratories (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop Simulators (HILS), and Flight Management System (FMS) Lab capabilities.

The selected candidate will serve as a key member of the BT&E leadership team, responsible for planning, executing, and monitoring control accounts that enable critical laboratory operations, modernization efforts, technology investments, and customer-funded development activities. This role works closely with engineering leaders, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), program customers, finance, planning, and functional leadership to ensure successful execution of scope, schedule, and cost commitments.

We are seeking candidates who are highly collaborative, analytical, and proactive leaders with a passion for driving execution excellence across complex technical environments.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Serves as Control Account Manager (CAM) for assigned BT&E laboratory and capability development scope.
* Leads Earned Value Management (EVM) execution, including baseline planning, work authorization, forecasting, variance analysis, and corrective action development.
* Partners with engineering and laboratory leaders to develop executable plans supporting laboratory operations, sustainment, and modernization initiatives.
* Monitors cost, schedule, and technical performance against approved baselines and develops recovery plans when necessary.
* Coordinates cross-functional execution activities across engineering, finance, planning, procurement, facilities, information technology, and operations teams.
* Supports development of Basis of Estimates (BOEs), Rough Order Magnitude (ROM) estimates, and proposal activities for internal and external customers.
* Develops program metrics, performance reporting, and executive-level briefings to support leadership decision-making.
* Performs Estimate-at-Complete (EAC) and Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) assessments and supports monthly business rhythm activities.
* Identifies risks and opportunities associated with laboratory infrastructure, test capability development, resource planning, and customer commitments.
* Supports Integrated Baseline Reviews (IBRs), audits, customer reviews, and compliance activities.
* Leads process improvement initiatives focused on affordability, operational efficiency, and business performance.
  

  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Bachelor's degree or higher
* 3+ years of experience performing in a finance, scheduling, industrial engineering, change management, strategy, business support services, program management, project management or business operations role
* Experience managing cost and schedule performance using Earned-Value Management (EVM) principles
* Experience utilizing Microsoft Office applications such as SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Microsoft Project

**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):**

* Experience developing Basis of Estimates (BOEs) and supporting proposal activities
* Experience performing Estimate-at-Complete (EAC) forecasting and variance analysis
* Experience with Cobra, Open Plan, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or related program management tools

**Sales Representative – Altadena Fire Rebuilds (Residential Construction)**  
**Pacific Prestige Properties Inc. | Eagle Rock, Los Angeles, CA**

Pacific Prestige Properties Inc. is looking for an experienced, motivated **Sales Representative** to help Altadena families rebuild their homes after the Eaton Fire. We are actively working on ground-up rebuilds in Altadena. This role reaches out to homeowners who have pulled or applied for rebuild permits and guides them from the first phone call to a signed contract and a finished home.

This is more than a sales job. Many of these homeowners lost everything. They are dealing with insurance claims, permits, architects and a lot of uncertainty. We need someone who knows construction, listens with patience and empathy, and can earn trust by being honest, organized and dependable. You will be calling people on a hard road, and how you treat them matters as much as closing the deal.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Outreach & Lead Development*

* Make high-volume outbound calls to homeowners who have pulled or applied for rebuild permits in Altadena and nearby fire-affected areas.
* Research permit records and keep the lead list organized, accurate and current in our CRM.
* Follow up consistently by phone, email and text, and set in-person or virtual consultations.
* Build referral relationships with architects, designers, insurance adjusters, public adjusters, lenders and community groups involved in the rebuild.
* Represent the company at community meetings, rebuild workshops and local events.

*Consultation & Sales*

* Run consultations that cover each family's goals, timeline, insurance situation and budget.
* Explain the rebuild process clearly: plans, permitting, scheduling, materials and costs.
* Present proposals for full rebuilds, ADUs and related scopes, then negotiate and close contracts.
* Help homeowners make the most of their insurance proceeds and budget with realistic, cost-effective solutions.
* Keep homeowners informed throughout the sales and construction process.

*Design & Materials*

* Help clients choose layouts, finishes, colors and materials.
* Recommend fire-resistant materials and construction methods that meet current code and wildfire requirements.
* Balance quality, look, durability and cost while respecting each family's taste and budget.
* Work with architects, designers, engineers and vendors as needed.

*Construction Knowledge & Cost Management*

* Understand ground-up residential construction methods, materials, labor costs and timelines.
* Write clear, detailed scopes of work and spot extra costs or challenges early.
* Understand construction pricing, budgeting and project profitability.
* Keep every proposal realistic, financially responsible and within the client's budget.

*Project Coordination & Oversight*

* Stay involved after the sale so the handoff from planning to construction goes smoothly.
* Coordinate with project managers, subcontractors and our production team on scope, quality and schedule.
* Keep clients updated on progress, changes and expectations.
* Own client satisfaction an

**What We're Looking For**  
We want someone who combines construction knowledge, sales skill and real care for the people we serve. You know how to listen, understand what a family needs and turn that into a realistic plan to rebuild their home. Our goal at Pacific Prestige Properties is to help Altadena come back stronger and to give every family a transparent, professional and well-managed rebuild from start to finish.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $250,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Organization Overview**

Family & Child Empowerment Services (FACES) provides families who live and work in San Francisco with high-quality early childhood education and enrichment; job support, training, and placement; and comprehensive family support services and referrals. Our mission is to empower families who live and work in San Francisco to transform their futures through evidence-based educational and economic opportunities.

**Position Summary**

As the Operations Coordinator, you are an integrity driven person at the center of the day-to-day operations and activities at the Bayview Child Development Center. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented and enjoys delivering great customer service in an educational setting. You have a passion for developing efficient systems to support operations and take pride in maintaining a welcoming, organized and safe environment. You are able to find harmony while holding multiple responsibilities and are thorough with everything you accomplish. You are empathetic and deeply committed to equitable service for all the children, families and staff.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Provide general administrative support with a preference to support the opening shift at the school, receiving and greeting all visitors, taking on complex copying jobs, front desk reception, and routing center mail and deliveries.

* Assist with planning, advertising, and hosting student and family events.
* Assist with school-wide communication, including newsletters, flyers, and brochures.
* Manage centralized inventory of supplies and materials and order center supplies as needed.
* In partnership with the enrollment department, assist with new family orientations and enrollment process including scheduling intakes, participating in educating families on center-based systems.
* Work closely with our partners to maintain compliance and complete monthly reports.
* Identify gaps in operations work and develop systems to support efficiency and sustainability

**Minimum Qualifications**:

*You have a solid mix of the following knowledge, ability, skills and experience:*

* 2-3 years of experience working in a bustling, high energy and dynamic collaborative office environment (school-based environment a plus).

* Bilingual (Spanish/English) preferred
* Ability to exercise good judgment and discretion in handling confidential materials and matters.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to details; ability to work accurately, independently and manage multiple projects effectively.
* Ability to frequently lift a range of weight from ten (10) to forty (40) pounds
* Ability to relate and communicate to individuals from diverse ethnic, cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds and to work with them in a fair, supportive and cooperative manner.
* Proficient in computer navigation, communication, MS Office and client database systems
* Ability to meet and maintain required state, federal, local, and CDC standards (including but not limited to fingerprint clearance, negative TB test, First Aid, CPR)
* A deep commitment to aligning all program practices to FACES values, especially around equity, inclusion, and belonging for all our stakeholder
* Strong passion for and a desire to humbly reflect and grow in pursuit of our mission
* Completion of 6-12 ECE units to assist with ratio in the morning or breaks if needed
* A sense of humor- we believe joy and justice go hand in hand!

**What We Offer**

* Hourly rate range is $36.00-$40.00 based on experience
* Healthcare premiums 100% paid for employees and 25% paid for dependents
* Three weeks of vacation, personal and floating holidays, twelve sick days, ten paid holidays (including one-week winter closure between Christmas and New Year’s) and a day off for your birthday!
* A retirement plan with employer match up to 7% of your salary
* A chance to positively impact the lives of young children and their families
* A fun, dynamic and collaborative working environment
* Opportunity to join a movement to achieve educational, economic, and racial justice!

Sales/MarketingHybrid Remote, New York, New York

### **Description**

At **MMGY Global,** we believe nothing shapes your view of the world like travel. So every day, we share our clients’ stories from a perspective that inspires people to see the world differently. Our personalized service and strategy connect media, consumers and influencers across the globe, taking people to new places and changing their views for the better. At MMGY, we inspire people to go places.

We have an immediate opening for an **Account Coordinator** in our **New York** office.

Go places with us! At **MMGY**, we inspire people to go places through our award-winning representation work, which includes public relations, integrated marketing, travel trade and more. If you are looking for an agency home in **New York** where your career path is our priority, let’s talk. Keeping our executives engaged and fulfilled is just as important as keeping our clients happy. With a specialization in international destinations and tourism boards around the world, we have an exciting roster of clients for which we are seeking a talented **BILINGUAL (ENGLISH/SPANISH) ACCOUNT COORDINATOR** who has a passion for travel. If you are outgoing, innovative, eager to grow and resourceful then this job is for you.

We are seeking a motivated professional with 1–2 years of experience in public relations, marketing or travel trade to support our international tourism clients. The role involves coordinating and implementing programs across **travel trade engagement, integrated marketing, public relations, events and project management**, working closely with clients, industry partners and internal teams.

### **Duties will include:**

* Provide day-to-day account support, including market intelligence, project briefs, media monitoring, client reporting and administrative coordination.
* Support the execution of integrated public relations, marketing and travel trade programs for destination and hospitality clients.
* Draft and edit press releases, media pitches, talking points and other communications materials.
* Conduct media outreach, respond to journalist inquiries and coordinate interview and travel requests.
* Maintain media databases, monitor coverage, prepare clipping reports and track PR results.
* Coordinate media familiarization trips, including itinerary development, journalist recruitment and in-destination hosting.
* Support travel trade engagement, including tour operator and travel advisor partnerships, training programs, trade shows and familiarization trips, as needed.
* Assist with the planning and execution of media events, promotional activations and special projects.
* Manage project timelines, deliverables, budgets, and follow-up with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
* Coordinate marketing materials, presentations, campaign assets and partner deliverables.
* Prepare activity reports and track results across PR, marketing and travel trade initiatives.
* Collaborate with account teams to develop creative story angles, campaign ideas and client opportunities.
* Domestic and international travel may be required.

### **Required Skills**

* 1–2 years of experience in public relations, marketing, travel trade, communications or project coordination.
* Experience in the tourism, travel or hospitality industry highly preferred.
* Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.
* Strong writing and editing skills, with an interest in media relations and storytelling.
* Familiarity with media outreach, press materials, media monitoring and reporting.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with clients, journalists, industry partners, vendors and internal teams.
* Strong attention to detail, initiative, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with travel trade, marketing campaigns and industry partnerships preferred.

*This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected of the Account Coordinator. It is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of all duties and responsibilities.*

**Salary Range: $46,000–$50,000**

MMGY Global provides a comprehensive PTO + benefits package that includes a hybrid telework policy. Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by the employer for a visa. MMGY Global is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Who Are We? We’re a travel-obsessed collective of more than 800 people across the country and around the globe. And when we say we inspire people to go places, we mean ALL people. That’s why we’re focused on nurturing a workforce that is representative of the places we visit.

new_jobs.title: Video Production Coordinator (Consultant)
new_jobs.description:
As the leading global type 1 diabetes (T1D) research and advocacy organization, Breakthrough T1D helps make everyday life with T1D better while driving toward cures. We invest in the most promising research to turn ideas into life-changing therapies and devices. We work with government, regulatory officials, and insurance companies to address issues that impact the T1D community - breaking through barriers that limit access to care worldwide. We provide resources and guidance that makes it easier to live and thrive with T1D. This is more than a moment - we're empowering a movement for the T1D community. Share your support and help educate and empower individuals facing type 1 diabetes.

Our mission is to improve lives today and tomorrow by accelerating life changing breakthroughs to treat, prevent and ultimately, cure T1D and its complications. **Always, we are guided by a single purpose: As we drive towards curing type 1 diabetes, we help make everyday life better for the people who face it** .

**Position Summary**

  

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Multimedia and Digital Content, you assist with behind the scenes video work: the person who helps turn a request into a finished, on-brand video, on schedule. You support the intake of video requests, coordination of in-studio, remote, and on-location shoot, and keep scripts, reviews, approvals, and deliverables moving. You also support post-production and keep our video assets organized and easy to find. Working across Marketing, Development, Advocacy, Research, Medical Affairs, Chapters, and Events, you help ensure every video reflects one consistent Breakthrough T1D brand and supports our overall marketing strategy.

  

**As part of this position, you will:**

* Support in-house studio, remote, and on-location productions, including setup, filming support, and wrap.

* Handle scheduling and logistics for on-site and remote shoots, including talent and stakeholder coordination, locations, equipment, run-of-show, and travel.

* Gather and organize the source content each project needs, such as photos, footage, data, quotes, and approved messaging.

* Assist with post-production, including ensuring final delivery in the formats each channel requires, and cataloging of finished and raw digital assets so they can be found and reused.

* Perform quality control on all final deliverables, checking accuracy, brand and style consistency, audio and visual quality, captions, and accessibility before anything is released.

* Operate professional video equipment for in-office filming.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to keep video content consistent with Breakthrough T1D brand guidelines and aligned with our overall marketing strategy.

* Travel to film off-site as needed. Travel is occasional.

Perform other video production duties as assigned.  

  

How You’ll Spend Your Time

**Time**

**60%**

**Production Support and Logistics**

Supporting studio, remote, and on-location shoots; scheduling talent, locations, and equipment; operating video equipment; and travel as needed.

**40%**

**Post-Production, Quality Control, and Asset Management**

Assisting with editing and delivery, quality-checking final deliverables, and cataloging digital assets.

Engagement Details

* **Structure:** Independent contractor engagement. Hours are approximately 40 horus per week, with flexibility based on project load.

* **Schedule:** In the New York City office as needed based on production schedule. Remaining hours are remote.

* **Travel:** Availability to film off-site is required. Travel is occasional.

  

**You’re Good At**

* **Organization and prioritization:** You keep many projects moving at once, set realistic timelines, and hold stakeholders to them without losing goodwill.

* **Attention to detail:** You catch the details others miss, from a misspelled name on a lower third to a missing caption or an off-brand color.

* **Production logistics:** You coordinate people, locations, equipment, and schedules so that shoot days run smoothly.

* **Collaboration:** You work easily with colleagues across departments, take feedback in stride, and consolidate competing input into clear direction.

* **Composure under deadlines:** You stay calm and solution-oriented when a schedule shifts or a shoot day does not go as planned.

  

**You Bring (Qualifications** )

* 2 or more years of relevant experience in video production, production coordination, or a related role, in-house or agency-side.

* Hands-on experience supporting studio, remote, and on-location shoots, including scheduling and logistics.

* Experience operating professional video equipment such as cameras, lighting, and audio.

* Working knowledge of video editing and post-production workflows, and the ability to support an editor with delivery and file management.

* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize competing requests and meet tight deadlines.

* Strong written communication skills, and a high level of attention to detail and quality control.

* Comfort using project management and digital asset management tools.

* Availability to work in the New York City office as needed and to travel occasionally for off-site shoots.

* Experience with scripting and storyboarding is a strong advantage.

* Experience producing video for social media and digital channels, including captioning and accessibility best practices, is a strong advantage.

Salary Range: $55k - $70k

**Essential Functions:**

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or controls.

new_jobs.description:
Job Title: Front Desk & Administrative Coordinator

America Works of New York | Midtown, NY

Compensation & Schedule

* Compensation: $25/hour during a short probationary period, with a $50,000 annual salary upon successful completion and approval.

* Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision.

* Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM?5:00 PM.

* Position Type: Full-Time, On-Site.

About America Works

America Works is a pioneer and recognized leader in workforce development. Its proven approach has become a model for agencies and organizations across the country looking to build effective employment programs. As a 100% woman-owned business, America Works brings a people-first perspective to everything it does.

What has remained constant throughout the organization's history is its commitment to the people it serves and the people who make its mission possible. Joining America Works means becoming part of an organization with a respected reputation, an established model for success, and a mission that makes a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Position Overview

America Works is seeking a friendly, organized, and dependable Front Desk & Administrative Coordinator to support daily office operations and assist with client engagement. This individual will serve as one of the first points of contact for clients and visitors while providing administrative support, conducting outbound client outreach, and assisting with special projects and program activities.

The position will work closely with our Ticket to Work program, which supports individuals receiving Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits who are interested in exploring employment opportunities.

The ideal candidate is customer-service oriented, detail-oriented, comfortable communicating with clients over the phone, and able to balance front desk responsibilities with administrative and project-based assignments.

Key Responsibilities

* Front Desk & Reception: Greet and assist clients and visitors, answer incoming calls, direct inquiries, and maintain a welcoming and professional office environment.

* Administrative Support: Provide general administrative assistance, including scanning, filing, organizing documents, maintaining records, and supporting daily office operations.

* Client Outreach: Conduct outbound calls to clients to provide program updates, follow up on participation, share information, and encourage continued engagement.

* Office Coordination: Monitor office supply inventory, place orders, organize materials, and ensure the office remains well-stocked and organized.

* Client Assistance: Distribute MetroCard/OMNY and other approved client resources as needed and assist with client communications and general inquiries.

* Special Projects & Events: Support the coordination of office initiatives, special projects, workshops, and client events.

* Ticket to Work Program Support: Work closely with the Ticket to Work team to assist with administrative coordination, client communication, outreach, and program-related activities.

* Team Collaboration: Provide flexible administrative and operational support to management and other departments as needed.

Why Join America Works?

A place to grow your career. America Works is committed to developing its employees and helping them reach their full potential. Many team members who began in entry-level and administrative roles have advanced into management positions, site director roles, grant writing, and other leadership opportunities across the organization.

Learn from experienced professionals. Receive hands-on training and guidance from experienced workforce development professionals while learning an established model for delivering employment services and supporting clients.

Gain exposure to workforce development and social policy. Work alongside programs connected to federal workforce initiatives and gain firsthand insight into how employment programs and public policy impact individuals and communities.

Be part of a supportive team. Take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating with experienced colleagues and management who are available to provide guidance and support.

Make a meaningful impact. Your work will directly contribute to creating a welcoming environment, keeping programs running smoothly, and ensuring clients receive the communication and support they need.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree required.

* Previous experience in reception, front desk operations, customer service, or administrative support preferred.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

* Comfortable making outbound calls and interacting with clients.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work in a fast-paced office environment.

* Professional, approachable, and dependable demeanor.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes initiative, and is comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with direct client interaction. The successful candidate will play an important role in keeping the office organized, supporting program operations, and ensuring clients receive timely and professional assistance.

new_jobs.description:
University Settlement partners with 40,000+ New Yorkers in Lower Manhattan and Brooklyn every year to build on our collective strengths as we achieve healthy, stable, and remarkable lives. For nearly 140 years, we’ve fought poverty and systemic inequality by building highly effective social services in collaboration with our neighbors. Established in 1886 as the first Settlement House in the United States, we bring the values of that movement into the 21st century by meeting New Yorkers where they live, listening deeply to all perspectives, and creating space for responsive cooperation.

Joining with our neighbors to make stable foundations where people of all ages can grow and pursue their dreams, we build community strength. We infuse a commitment to civic engagement, equality, and communal action into each of our programs, which include early childhood education, youth development, healthy aging, mental health and wellness, English classes for adult immigrants, community centers, and the arts.

The Outreach Coordinator ensures effective outreach to hard-to-reach youth and young adults who do not participate in afterschool or community center programs. The outreach function requires a sensitive individual with the skills and personality to forge relationships with youth who are chronically absent or have dropped out of school and persuade them to engage in Beacon programming. The Outreach Coordinator acts as a “credible messenger” with strong community connections, a good grasp of neighborhood dynamics and ability to address conflicts that have potential to undermine community cohesion. They also have the experience, skills and personal qualities to function as mentors to youth and young adults they enroll in the Beacon. Their priority will be to facilitate a respectful relationship between all community members in the East Village/ Lower East Side and increase Beacon evening and weekend program participation.

The Outreach Coordinator will also plan and facilitate community-building and enrichment activities for at-risk youth . Here, the Outreach Coordinator will be responsible for creating dynamic, engaging, experiential programming for Beacon participants. They will work with Beacon Activity Specialists, Group Leaders, and the Beacon Program Director to create activities in the areas of, but not limited to, the Arts; including Performing and Visual, Recreation/Sports, and Community/Team Building. The Outreach Coordinator will also work with other service providers, both internal and external, to create programming that reflects University Settlement’s core values and mission.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist other Activity Specialists with providing general supervision of Beacon office and shared space.
* Provide a welcoming, professional demeanor to participants and visitors to the program.
* Collect basic information pertaining to young people’s needs.
* Plan and facilitate enrichment activities for Wednesday to Friday night programming.
* Facilitate large and small discussion groups and other activities to foster a sense of community.
* Strategize and achieve enrollment goals as specified by Beacon Program Director.
* Ensure youth receive referrals to appropriate University Settlement programs as well as to other community resources.
* Engage in community conversations/networking with other stake holders (i.e. school leadership team, service providers, school safety).
* Maintain all agency reporting requirements and inform supervisor of all program activities and changes.
* Meet weekly with Supervisor for planning and evaluation.
* Participate in agency-wide initiatives as required by supervisor.
* Complete other relevant duties as requested by supervisor.

**Qualifications:**

* Highschool diploma or HSE required. Knowledge of youth issues and/or familiarity working with at-risk, street involved, or LGBT youth population.
* Demonstrated experience with group facilitation.
* Knowledge of youth empowerment philosophy and harm reduction.
* Training in de-escalation/ conflict mediation helpful.
* Ability to apply positive youth development principles.
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries between self and youth.
* Commitment to professionalism and ability to serve as a staff representative of University Settlement.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills required.
* Self-starter able to work independently.

Help shape how a national retail design and construction organization operates. You will unite internal teams and service providers around clear standards, strong governance, and decision-ready information, while advising senior leaders on outcomes, risks, and priorities.

As a Business Operations Lead Manager on the Retail Design and Construction (RD&C) team, you will lead business operations for a multi-billion-dollar retail construction program delivered across the 48 contiguous states. You will bring 50 internal professionals and more than 400 external specialists across three real estate service providers into one operating model. You will set the roadmap for process, governance, technology, data, financial discipline, and staffing, and serve as the senior operations point of accountability for service-provider performance. You will represent RD&C to business leaders and stakeholders across the bank, and partner with other Global Real Estate (GRE) functions worldwide to keep practices consistent. This highly visible role offers the opportunity to build an operations function that becomes a model for the broader organization and the industry.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the operating model and multi-year roadmap for process, governance, technology, data, and staffing.
* Set measurable operating standards, benchmark performance against industry leaders, and drive continuous improvement.
* Standardize design and project management processes and reporting across internal teams and service partners.
* Create one delivery model across the company and multiple service providers — with shared objectives, clear roles, joint planning, and effective issue resolution — to drive frictionless execution across internal and external teams.
* Own service-level agreements and key performance indicators; lead performance reviews, enforce contract requirements, and oversee remediation plans.
* Lead workforce and vendor capacity planning against program demand and present recommendations for leadership approval.
* Partner with Controls Management, Audit, and Compliance to support adherence to internal controls, policies, and contractual obligations; establish governance routines, decision rights, escalation paths, and operating forums with clear documentation of decisions, owners, and actions.
* Lead RD&C's evaluation and adoption of design, construction, and real estate technology; prioritize platform improvements, integrations, and data flows in partnership with JPMC Global Real Estate, Technology, and Service Partner Technology leaders.
* Act as a trusted partner to senior bank leaders and business clients and represent RD&C in executive forums, providing clear updates on outcomes, risks, trade-offs, and decisions needed, supported by executive-ready materials.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team with an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 10+ years of experience in real estate, design and construction, program or project management, or business operations.
* Demonstrated senior leadership of large, complex programs delivered through multiple vendors or service providers.
* Proven success building and governing service-provider partnerships at scale, including performance measures, contract enforcement, and policy adherence.
* Experience creating operating models, governance structures, decision rights, and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
* Strong executive presence and experience advising senior leaders in a matrixed organization with competing priorities.
* Advanced negotiation, conflict management, vendor management, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience supporting multi-site retail, branch, or other distributed-footprint construction programs.

**About Zip Security**
======================

Cybersecurity for growing businesses is broken — even enterprises spend heavily across hundreds of disconnected tools for marginal real-world benefit. For startups and mid-sized firms, this gap often means forgoing security entirely, or cobbling together a solution that leaves them vulnerable in other ways. At Zip Security, we build solutions that make enterprise cybersecurity effective and doable for growing businesses of all kinds, whether or not they have a security team in house.  
  
Our product is a complete security program that automates device management, endpoint security, identity and access management, compliance, and managed IT and security operations to keep teams of all kinds protected. We help our customers pick their right security frameworks, correctly deploy the tools, policies, and controls they need, and keep everything enforced over time, so their business is protected and compliant, 24/7.

Zip is at the cutting edge of what’s possible in cybersecurity, and dedicated to delivering value for our customers. It’s a big part of why we’re backed by Ballistic Ventures. Major platforms are opening APIs that enable automated management at scale, new government initiatives are surfacing global threat data, and we're positioned to be the first to properly integrate all of it. We're looking for driven, talented people to help us get there. If this resonates with you, we invite you to consider building alongside our team.

**About The Role**
==================

As a **Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Zip Security**, you’ll have the opportunity to kick-start your sales career at a rapidly growing cybersecurity startup. Having built our founding cohort of SDRs, we're excited to continue scaling our team with ambitious, hardworking individuals who are eager to learn, challenge themselves, and grow alongside us.

You'll be on the front lines of our go-to-market efforts, connecting with prospective customers, uncovering business challenges, and generating meaningful opportunities for our sales team. As Zip continues to scale, our SDR team will play a pivotal role in our international expansion, helping us break into new markets and build our global presence. You'll work closely with Account Executives, Marketing, and Sales Leadership, receiving hands-on coaching and developing the foundational skills to build a successful career in sales.

**Your career path at Zip is yours to build.** Whether you aspire to become an Account Executive, grow into sales leadership, explore partnerships, or pursue another area of our go-to-market organization, we're excited to help you build the foundation to get there. As Zip grows, we want you to grow with us.

**What You Will Build at Zip Security**
---------------------------------------

* Generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting across phone, email, and LinkedIn.
* Research prospective customers and develop an understanding of their business and security challenges.
* Play a key role in Zip's international expansion by identifying opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and helping establish our presence in new markets.
* Build strong prospecting, cold-calling, discovery, and objection-handling skills through hands-on experience and coaching.
* Qualify prospective customers and book high-quality meetings for Account Executives, contributing directly to Zip's growth.
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to experiment with messaging, targeting, and outbound strategies.
* Take ownership of your performance, track your progress, and consistently work toward exceeding your goals.
* Contribute ideas and help shape the culture and processes of our growing sales development team.

**What We're Looking For**

* You have **0–1 years of professional experience**. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* You're ambitious, hardworking, and genuinely excited about building a career in sales.
* You're naturally curious, personable, and enjoy connecting with new people.
* You're a strong communicator who is excited to pick up the phone and engage with prospective customers.
* You're resilient, persistent, and motivated by challenges rather than discouraged by setbacks.
* You're highly coachable, receptive to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.
* You're competitive and goal-oriented while also being invested in the success of your teammates.

We believe great teams are built by curious people who care deeply about learning, collaboration, and ownership. At Zip Security, you’ll have the autonomy to contribute ideas, shape decisions, and help build both our product and our culture. If you’re excited about the role, we encourage you to apply — even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

**What We Offer**

* 401(k) plan to help you invest in your future

* Develop and communicate STEM/STEAM guidance, instructional resources, and implementation supports for schools and districts.

* Master’s degree in education, curriculum and instruction, educational leadership, STEM education, or a related field.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Sassetti is a well-established public accounting firm in the Chicago area, providing full-service tax, accounting, audit, and advisory services throughout Chicagoland and beyond. We pair the resources and reputation of a large firm with the personal, one-on-one attention of a smaller one.

We empower our team through development initiatives and a culture built on strong, lasting relationships with our clients and our people. These principles have guided us for decades.

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, technology-minded Executive Assistant to partner with our Managing Partner and support other partners or a practice group. Beyond managing a calendar, this role helps the Managing Partner manage the business: keeping priorities organized, communication moving, and projects progressing across the firm, anticipating needs, solving problems independently, embracing technology and AI, and handling confidential information with discretion.

This is a full-time, exempt, salaried position reporting to the Managing Partner, working Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with an onsite requirement of 80%–100% of the time.

Executive Assistant Responsibilities:

Calendar, Communication & Partner Support:

* Manage partners' calendars end to end, prioritizing client meetings, deadlines, and leadership time; plan around busy seasons and filing deadlines and flag conflicts early.

* Screen and organize email, phone calls, and incoming requests; draft correspondence in the partner's voice for approval.

* Prepare agendas, briefing materials, and committee meeting materials; record minutes and track action items, commitments, and open items to completion; assist with practice-area dashboards and WIP or billing summaries.

* Book travel, lodging, and client or networking events.

* Handle sensitive firm matters and confidential client information with full discretion, following data security and document retention policies.

Client Service & Engagement Support:

* Act as a polished first point of contact for clients, referral sources, and vendors, and resolve service issues.

* Coordinate client onboarding, engagement letters, and e-signature routing; prepare proposals, RFP responses, presentations, reports, and pitch materials and manage submission deadlines.

* Track client due dates, extensions, and deliverables, flagging at-risk items before deadlines.

* Support billing by reviewing invoices and following up on WIP and past-due balances.

Events, Projects & Firm Operations:

* Plan and coordinate partner retreats, firm meetings, and staff and client events, including budgets and vendors.

* Lead special projects and firm initiatives, such as office moves and system rollouts.

* Track partners' CPE credits, licenses, and memberships, and register them for courses and conferences.

* Serve as backup for reception, office management, and other administrative staff as needed.

* Build PTO and busy-season coverage plans; document and improve SOPs, templates, and checklists.

Technology & Process Improvement:

* Help evaluate, implement, and drive adoption of new technologies, workflows, automation, and firm-approved AI tools.

* Streamline administrative processes and improve productivity, communication, meeting preparation, and the employee and client experience using technology and AI.

* Coordinate with internal team members and outside vendors on technology and operational initiatives.

Executive Assistant Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant experience supporting senior executives or firm leadership

* Associate's or bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience

* Prior experience in a public accounting, legal, or other professional services firm preferred

* Advanced Microsoft 365 proficiency (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams); familiarity with practice management or billing software, and e-signature, document management, and client portal tools preferred

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

* Outstanding organization and attention to detail; proven ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines and follow tasks through with minimal oversight

* Demonstrated ability to anticipate needs, take initiative, and solve problems independently

* Sound judgment and a high standard of confidentiality

* Experience supporting new technologies, systems, or process improvements; experience with AI tools, or genuine enthusiasm for learning how AI can improve the way we work

* Strong project management and event-planning skills; moves comfortably between executive scheduling, events, and technology rollouts

* Professional, approachable, and resourceful; stays steady during busy season and represents the firm well to clients and colleagues at all levels

Executive Assistant Working Conditions:

* On-site at our Chicago-area office 80%–100% of the time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

* Standard, primarily sedentary office environment; occasional extended hours during tax season and as business needs dictate.

Executive Assistant Pay Range: $75,000 to $105,000 per year, commensurate with experience

What We Offer:

* Medical, dental, and vision

* 401(k) Safe Harbor with 3% employer contribution

* Generous PTO

* Holidays – Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Day After Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, New Year's Day

* Paid holiday break the last week of the year and Summer Fridays in July

* Bonus program and incentive opportunities

* Professional development opportunities

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.
